abaddon_death_coil.name: Mist Coil
abaddon_death_coil.desc: Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist that can damage an enemy unit or heal a friendly unit at the cost of some of Abaddon's health.

abaddon_aphotic_shield.name: Aphotic Shield
abaddon_aphotic_shield.desc:
Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

abaddon_frostmourne.name: Curse of Avernus
abaddon_frostmourne.desc: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by 100%.

abaddon_withering_mist.name: Withering Mist
abaddon_withering_mist.desc: Damaging enemies applies the Withering Mist debuff for 5s. Affected enemies have their Health Restoration reduced by 24.5% if they are below 40% HP.

abaddon_borrowed_time.name: Borrowed Time
abaddon_borrowed_time.desc:
When activated, dispels you and all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm. If the ability is not on cooldown, it will automatically activate if your health falls below 400.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

special_bonus_unique_abaddon_3.name: +65 Curse of Avernus Attack Speed Bonus

abyssal_underlord_firestorm.name: Firestorm
abyssal_underlord_firestorm.desc: Calls down waves of fire that damage enemy units in the target area, burning for additional damage over time.

abyssal_underlord_pit_of_malice.name: Pit of Malice
abyssal_underlord_pit_of_malice.desc: A deadly pit is conjured at the target location; any unit that enters will be damaged and rooted. Each enemy unit within the pit are affected by the root only every 3.6 seconds.

abyssal_underlord_atrophy_aura.name: Atrophy Aura
abyssal_underlord_atrophy_aura.desc: Nearby enemy units are weakened, losing a portion of their base damage. If an enemy dies while under this effect, Underlord gains temporary bonus damage.

abyssal_underlord_raid_boss.name: Invading Force
abyssal_underlord_raid_boss.desc: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain Damage Reduction and Movement Speed. Allies receive 2x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.

abyssal_underlord_dark_portal.name: Fiend's Gate
abyssal_underlord_dark_portal.desc: Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for 3.5 seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least 1500 away from each other.

abyssal_underlord_abyssal_horde.name: Abyssal Horde
abyssal_underlord_abyssal_horde.desc:
After teleporting through the Fiend's Gate, Underlord brings forth a Warrior or an Archer to aid him every 2s that last for the duration of the Fiend's Gate.

The Warrior burns mana every hit, and deals magical damage to whoever kills it. The Archer has a passive movement speed aura.

alchemist_acid_spray.name: Acid Spray
alchemist_acid_spray.desc: Sprays high-pressure acid across a target area. Enemy units who step across the contaminated terrain take damage per second and have their armor reduced.

alchemist_unstable_concoction.name: Unstable Concoction
alchemist_unstable_concoction.desc: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After 5 seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after 5.5 seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.

alchemist_corrosive_weaponry.name: Corrosive Weaponry
alchemist_corrosive_weaponry.desc:
Alchemist coats his weapons and empowers his spells with an acid that applies a stacking slow and base attack damage reduction to enemies hit.

Attacks apply 2 stacks. Unstable Concoction applies 1 stack per second of brew time.

alchemist_berserk_potion.name: Berserk Potion
alchemist_berserk_potion.desc:
Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

alchemist_goblins_greed.name: Greevil's Greed
alchemist_goblins_greed.desc: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next 40 seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.

alchemist_chemical_rage.name: Chemical Rage
alchemist_chemical_rage.desc:
Alchemist causes his Ogre to enter a chemically induced rage, reducing base attack cooldown and increasing movement speed and health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

alchemist_unstable_concoction_throw.name: Unstable Concoction Throw
alchemist_unstable_concoction_throw.desc: Throw it before it blows up!

ancient_apparition_cold_feet.name: Cold Feet
ancient_apparition_cold_feet.desc: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time. If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range from the initial location, it will be stunned and frozen in place after 4 seconds.

ancient_apparition_ice_vortex.name: Ice Vortex
ancient_apparition_ice_vortex.desc: Creates a vortex of icy energy that slows, deals damage, and increases magic damage done to enemies in its range.

ancient_apparition_chilling_touch.name: Chilling Touch
ancient_apparition_chilling_touch.desc: Enhances Ancient Apparition's attack with increased range and a burst of magical damage and slow.

ancient_apparition_bone_chill.name: Bone Chill
ancient_apparition_bone_chill.desc: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.

ancient_apparition_ice_blast.name: Ice Blast
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.desc: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.

ancient_apparition_ice_blast_release.name: Release
ancient_apparition_ice_blast_release.desc: Releases the ice blast to explode at the tracer's current location. Can be cast while silenced.

antimage_mana_break.name: Mana Break
antimage_mana_break.desc: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.

antimage_blink.name: Blink
antimage_blink.desc: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.

antimage_counterspell.name: Counterspell
antimage_counterspell.desc: Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.

antimage_persectur.name: Persecutor
antimage_persectur.desc: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at 50% mana, up to max slow at 0% mana. No effect if enemy is above 50% mana.

antimage_mana_void.name: Mana Void
antimage_mana_void.desc: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies. The main target is also mini-stunned.

antimage_counterspell_ally.name: Counterspell Ally
antimage_counterspell_ally.desc: Counterspell Ally may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around an allied hero that blocks and reflects any targeted spells. Any time a spell is blocked by Counterspell or Counterspell Ally, an illusion of Anti-Mage will be created next to the enemy.

arc_warden_flux.name: Flux
arc_warden_flux.desc: Infuses a lone enemy unit with swirling, volatile energy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target. The damage is not applied if another enemy unit is near the target.

arc_warden_magnetic_field.name: Magnetic Field
arc_warden_magnetic_field.desc: Arc Warden generates a circular distortion field of magnetic energy. The Magnetic Field grants bonus attack speed and protects allied units within it by evading attacks coming from outside the field. The Magnetic Field pulls runes, and runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.

arc_warden_spark_wraith.name: Spark Wraith
arc_warden_spark_wraith.desc: Summons a Spark Wraith that slowly materializes and patrols a targeted area until an enemy comes within its range. Once a target has been found the wraith fuses with them, dealing magical damage and slowing the unit.

arc_warden_runic_infusion.name: Runic Infusion
arc_warden_runic_infusion.desc: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +1.5 all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.

arc_warden_tempest_double.name: Tempest Double
arc_warden_tempest_double.desc:
Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.

The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.

axe_berserkers_call.name: Berserker's Call
axe_berserkers_call.desc: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.

axe_battle_hunger.name: Battle Hunger
axe_battle_hunger.desc: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.

axe_counter_helix.name: Counter Helix
axe_counter_helix.desc: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.

axe_culling_blade.name: Culling Blade
axe_culling_blade.desc:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.

axe_one_man_army.name: One Man Army
axe_one_man_army.desc: Axe gains Strength based on 50% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within 700 distance from Axe. The effect fades over 3s after approaching an ally.

bane_enfeeble.name: Enfeeble
bane_enfeeble.desc: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.

bane_brain_sap.name: Brain Sap
bane_brain_sap.desc: Feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing Bane and dealing damage.

bane_nightmare.name: Nightmare
bane_nightmare.desc:
Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely.

 Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.

bane_fiends_grip.name: Fiend's Grip
bane_fiends_grip.desc: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every 0.5 seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.

bane_ichor_of_nyctasha.name: Ichor of Nyctasha
bane_ichor_of_nyctasha.desc: Every time Bane kills an enemy hero or they die under the effect of Bane's debuff, they receive a Terror for the rest of the game that decreases their status resistance to Bane's subsequent debuffs.

batrider_sticky_napalm.name: Sticky Napalm
batrider_sticky_napalm.desc: Drenches an area in sticky oil, amplifying damage from Batrider's attacks and abilities and slowing the movement speed and turn rate of enemies. Additional casts of Sticky Napalm continue to increase damage, up to 20 stacks. Applies a small amount of damage with each cast.

batrider_flamebreak.name: Flamebreak
batrider_flamebreak.desc: Hurls an explosive cocktail that explodes when it reaches the target location, knocking back, slowing and dealing damage over time to enemies in the area.

batrider_firefly.name: Firefly
batrider_firefly.desc: Batrider takes to the skies, moving increasingly fast and laying down a trail of flames from the air. The fire damages any enemies it touches and destroys trees below Batrider. Maximum movement speed bonus is reached at the end of Firefly's duration.

batrider_smoldering_resin.name: Smoldering Resin
batrider_smoldering_resin.desc: Batrider's attacks apply a debuff that deals 20% of the attack damage every 1s for 2s.

batrider_flaming_lasso.name: Flaming Lasso
batrider_flaming_lasso.desc: Lassoes an enemy and drags them in Batrider's wake. Dragged units cannot move, attack, or use abilities. Teleporting or blinking will break the lasso.

special_bonus_unique_batrider_6.name: Attacks apply 1 Stack of Sticky Napalm

beastmaster_wild_axes.name: Wild Axes
beastmaster_wild_axes.desc: Beastmaster sends his axes flying and calls them home again, slicing through enemy units and trees along their path. Each axe can hit an enemy once, and amplifies subsequent damage from Beastmaster and his units.

beastmaster_summon_razorback.name: Summon Razorback
beastmaster_summon_razorback.desc: Beastmaster calls forth a Boar to aid in the battlefield. The Boar has a passive poison attack that slows attack and movement speeds.

beastmaster_summon_raptor.name: Summon Raptors
beastmaster_summon_raptor.desc: Beastmaster summons 2 hawks that circle around Beastmaster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every 4s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.

beastmaster_inner_beast.name: Inner Beast
beastmaster_inner_beast.desc: Untaps the inner fury of Beastmaster and units he controls, passively increasing their attack speed.

beastmaster_drums_of_slom.name: Drums of Slom
beastmaster_drums_of_slom.desc:
Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of 0.5s between hits after 20 attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.

Using Primal Roar counts as 10 attacks.

beastmaster_primal_roar.name: Primal Roar
beastmaster_primal_roar.desc: Beastmaster lets loose a deafening roar that stuns, and shoves open a path to its target. All units in the path of the roar are damaged, while units shoved aside by the roar have their movement and attack speed slowed. Additionally, Beastmaster and his units gain 40% movement speed for 2 seconds.

special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_5.name: +15 Movespeed to Beastmaster and his summons

special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_6.name: +250 Health to Beastmaster and his summons

beastmaster_hawk_dive.name: Dive Bomb
beastmaster_hawk_dive.desc: Flies towards the target enemy, dealing damage and rooting it.

beastmaster_boar_poison.name: Poison
beastmaster_boar_poison.desc: Inflicts a poison that slows attack and movement speeds.

beastmaster_greater_boar_poison.name: Poison
beastmaster_greater_boar_poison.desc: Inflicts a poison that slows attack and movement speeds.

beastmaster_rugged.name: Rugged
beastmaster_rugged.desc: Beastmaster's melee hero Damage Block Chance is increased from 50% to 100% versus non-hero units and non-building units.

bloodseeker_bloodrage.name: Bloodrage
bloodseeker_bloodrage.desc: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second.

bloodseeker_blood_bath.name: Blood Rite
bloodseeker_blood_bath.desc: Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After 2.9 seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.

bloodseeker_thirst.name: Thirst
bloodseeker_thirst.desc: Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below 100%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below 25%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.

bloodseeker_sanguivore.name: Sanguivore
bloodseeker_sanguivore.desc:
Bloodseeker restores some life when he kills a unit, equal to 30 health plus a percentage of the units max health.

Restores for half values if an ally kills a nearby enemy hero.

bloodseeker_rupture.name: Rupture
bloodseeker_rupture.desc: Causes an enemy unit's skin to rupture, dealing initial damage based on its current health. If the unit moves, it takes damage based on the distance moved.

bloodseeker_blood_mist.name: Blood Mist
bloodseeker_blood_mist.desc:
Bloodseeker sprays his blood continuously in the area around him, losing health to damage and slow his enemies. While active, Sanguivore's healing is increased. Cannot be turned off while on cooldown. 

Additionally, passively turns all your overheal from your own abilities into an all damage barrier up to 50% of Bloodseeker's Max Health. Barrier amount decays by 0.5% per second.

bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.name: Shuriken Toss
bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.desc: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed. The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a 1200 radius of each other.

bounty_hunter_jinada.name: Jinada
bounty_hunter_jinada.desc: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage and stealing some unreliable gold.

bounty_hunter_wind_walk.name: Shadow Walk
bounty_hunter_wind_walk.desc: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell. If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.

bounty_hunter_wind_walk_ally.name: Friendly Shadow
bounty_hunter_wind_walk_ally.desc: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is 0.5s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.

bounty_hunter_big_game_hunter.name: Big Game Hunter
bounty_hunter_big_game_hunter.desc: Bounty Hunter receives 15% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.

bounty_hunter_track.name: Track
bounty_hunter_track.desc: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.

bounty_hunter_cutpurse.name: Cutpurse
bounty_hunter_cutpurse.desc: Bounty Hunter steals 4 gold when targeting enemy heroes with his abilities or items.

brewmaster_thunder_clap.name: Thunder Clap
brewmaster_thunder_clap.desc: Slams the ground, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed and attack rate of nearby enemy units.

brewmaster_cinder_brew.name: Cinder Brew
brewmaster_cinder_brew.desc:
Rolls a barrel of ale at enemies that damages enemies along its path and spills out at the target location.

Any enemy in the path or the spill area is drenched in cinder brew, becoming slowed. If the enemy receives Magic or Pure damage, they will be ignited, extending the duration by 3s and causing them to take damage over time.

brewmaster_drunken_brawler.name: Drunken Brawler
brewmaster_drunken_brawler.desc:
Brewmaster can switch stances based on the elements he controls.

Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by 150% for 5s. If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by 2s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for 9s.

Earth Brawler gains bonus Magic Resistance and Armor.

Storm Brawler gains bonus Evasion and Movement Speed.

Fire Brawler gains bonus Attack Speed and chance to critical strike.

brewmaster_liquid_courage.name: Liquid Courage
brewmaster_liquid_courage.desc: When Brewmaster drops below 50% Health he gains a Status Resistance buff and his movement speed alternates every 1s between being faster and being slower. The effect becomes stronger at lower health, scaling from 0 up to max values at 20% Health.

brewmaster_primal_split.name: Primal Split
brewmaster_primal_split.desc: Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn. Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.

brewmaster_drunken_brawler_brew_up.name: Drunken Brawler - Brew Up
brewmaster_drunken_brawler_brew_up.desc: Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up and his stance becomes empowered. If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended. The cooldown starts when the effect ends.

brewmaster_primal_companion.name: Primal Companion
brewmaster_primal_companion.desc:
Creates a Brewling based on Brewmaster's current Drunken Brawler Stance.

A new Brewling cannot be resummoned for 3s if the current one takes damage from enemy Heroes or hero-controlled units. If the Brewling dies, the ability goes on cooldown for 70 seconds.

Only one Brewling can exist at a time. If Brewmaster uses Primal Split, the existing Brewling disappears.

brewmaster_earth_hurl_boulder.name: Hurl Boulder
brewmaster_earth_hurl_boulder.desc: Throws a boulder at a unit, doing damage and stunning it.

brewmaster_earth_spell_immunity.name: Earth Element
brewmaster_earth_spell_immunity.desc: Magic, status, and slow resistance increased.

brewmaster_storm_dispel_magic.name: Dispel Magic
brewmaster_storm_dispel_magic.desc:
Damages summoned units in an area and dispels most buffs or debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

brewmaster_storm_cyclone.name: Cyclone
brewmaster_storm_cyclone.desc: Encloses a unit in a tornado, removing it from the battlefield and deals 75 damage when after they land.

brewmaster_storm_wind_walk.name: Wind Walk
brewmaster_storm_wind_walk.desc: Provides temporary invisibility. Bonus movement speed and attack damage when invisible.

brewmaster_fire_phase.name: Permanent Phase
brewmaster_fire_phase.desc: Provides the Brewling with phased movement and bonus Status Resistance.

bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.name: Viscous Nasal Goo
bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.desc: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for 5 seconds. Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.

bristleback_quill_spray.name: Quill Spray
bristleback_quill_spray.desc: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback. Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last 14 seconds.

bristleback_bristleback.name: Bristleback
bristleback_bristleback.desc: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.

bristleback_hairball.name: Hairball
bristleback_hairball.desc: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.

bristleback_warpath.name: Warpath
bristleback_warpath.desc: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.

bristleback_prickly.name: Prickly
bristleback_prickly.desc: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.

bristleback_brawlers_grit.name: Brawler's Grit
bristleback_brawlers_grit.desc: Every time Bristleback is Stunned, Hexed, Feared, Taunted, or Rooted he gains a stacking buff for 8s that provides status resistance and debuff amplificiation, up to a maximum of 4 stacks.

broodmother_insatiable_hunger.name: Insatiable Hunger
broodmother_insatiable_hunger.desc: A violent lust for vital fluids increases Broodmother's attack damage and gives her and her Spiderlings a vampiric attack.

broodmother_spin_web.name: Spin Web
broodmother_spin_web.desc:
Spins a large web that grants Broodmother a passive movement speed increase and increases her Turn Rate, while in its vicinity, as well as giving free movement.

Spin Web can be cast from anywhere as long as the new web touches an existing web. Webs never expire, and can be manually destroyed. When the maximum limit of webs is exceeded, the oldest web disappears.

broodmother_incapacitating_bite.name: Incapacitating Bite
broodmother_incapacitating_bite.desc: Broodmother's venom cripples enemy units, causing her attacks to slow and giving the affected unit a chance to miss its attacks and extra damage from attacks.

broodmother_spiders_milk.name: Spider's Milk
broodmother_spiders_milk.desc: Whenever Broodmother kills a unit, she and all units under her control in a 600 radius receive a buff for 3s that heals them for a percentage of the victim's health every 0.5 seconds. Healing from creeps is reduced by 40%.

broodmother_spawn_spiderlings.name: Spawn Spiderlings
broodmother_spawn_spiderlings.desc: Broodmother injects her young into an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing them for 4 seconds. The spiderlings will hatch if the target is killed while under this influence.

broodmother_spawn_spiderite.name: Spawn Spiderling
broodmother_spawn_spiderite.desc: Applies debuff on attack. If debuffed unit dies, a spiderling will spawn.

centaur_hoof_stomp.name: Hoof Stomp
centaur_hoof_stomp.desc: After a brief windup, Centaur Warrunner slams the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. During the delay, he is disarmed but can move.

centaur_double_edge.name: Double Edge
centaur_double_edge.desc: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target. Deals extra damage based on your strength. Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.

centaur_return.name: Retaliate
centaur_return.desc: Centaur counters all attacks, dealing damage back to the attacker. Returns a fixed amount plus a percentage of your strength. Deals half damage to towers.

centaur_work_horse.name: Work Horse
centaur_work_horse.desc: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.

centaur_mount.name: Hitch A Ride
centaur_mount.desc: Centaur tosses an ally into a cart hitched behind him. While in the cart, the ally is invulnerable and can still cast and attack normally, but cannot move independently or be targeted by opponents. Increases the attack range of melee heroes by 200.

centaur_stampede.name: Stampede
centaur_stampede.desc: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.

centaur_horsepower.name: Horsepower
centaur_horsepower.desc:
Centaur Warrunner gains 30% of his strength as bonus movement speed.

 This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.

centaur_khan_endurance_aura.name: Swiftness Aura
centaur_khan_endurance_aura.desc: The fearsome Hellbear attacks more quickly and bullies nearby allies into following suit.

centaur_khan_war_stomp.name: War Stomp
centaur_khan_war_stomp.desc: The Centaur Conqueror's powerful hooves stomp the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemies. Heroes recover more quickly.

chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.name: Chaos Bolt
chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.desc: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.

chaos_knight_reality_rift.name: Reality Rift
chaos_knight_reality_rift.desc: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for 6s.

chaos_knight_chaos_strike.name: Chaos Strike
chaos_knight_chaos_strike.desc: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced.

chaos_knight_phantasm.name: Phantasm
chaos_knight_phantasm.desc:
Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal 100% damage, but take 350% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

chaos_knight_phantasmagoria.name: Phantasmagoria
chaos_knight_phantasmagoria.desc: All Chaos Knight Illusions are Strong Illusions and take less damage when near him.

chaos_knight_reins_of_chaos.name: Reins of Chaos
chaos_knight_reins_of_chaos.desc: Whenever illusions of Chaos Knight are created, there is a 50% chance that an additional 1 extra illusion will spawn.

chen_penitence.name: Penitence
chen_penitence.desc: Damages enemy unit, forces it to move slower and lets allies attack it more quickly.

chen_holy_persuasion.name: Holy Persuasion
chen_holy_persuasion.desc: Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty. Its maximum health is set to 400. Converted creeps will have increased movement speed and bonus damage. Chen may globally target his own creep if it has not taken damage in the last 3 seconds to unsummon it.

chen_divine_favor.name: Divine Favor
chen_divine_favor.desc:
Passively provides an aura that grants increased health regeneration. Can be cast on allies to provide them with bonus armor and increasing the healing and health regeneration they receive.

If cast on Chen, all units controlled by Chen receive the buff.

chen_hand_of_god.name: Hand of God
chen_hand_of_god.desc: Heals all allied heroes on the map as well as all units under Chen's control. A large heal is applied at first and a slow heal over time is applied for 10 seconds afterwards.

chen_martyrdom.name: Martyrdom
chen_martyrdom.desc: Sacrifice the life of this unit to damage an enemy for 25 + 20% of this unit's current health. Allies may also be targeted for a heal with 50% of the damage value.

clinkz_strafe.name: Strafe
clinkz_strafe.desc:
Clinkz gains attack speed and has bonus attack range. Any current Skeleton Archers within a 1200 radius of Clinkz also gain bonus attack range and 40% of the attack speed bonus. 

 Casting Strafe does not break Skeleton Walk invisibility.

clinkz_searing_arrows.name: Searing Arrows
clinkz_searing_arrows.desc:
Imbues Clinkz's arrows with fire for extra damage.

Skeleton Archers will fire Searing Arrows at targets Clinkz attacks for 50% damage.

clinkz_death_pact.name: Death Pact
clinkz_death_pact.desc: Clinkz consumes the target enemy creep or friendly Skeleton Archer, healing and gaining max health. Does not take Clinkz out of Skeleton Walk.

clinkz_burning_barrage.name: Burning Barrage
clinkz_burning_barrage.desc: CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.

clinkz_burning_army.name: Burning Army
clinkz_burning_army.desc: Summons a row of Burning Skeleton Archers in the target location.

clinkz_wind_walk.name: Skeleton Walk
clinkz_wind_walk.desc:
Clinkz moves invisibly through units until the moment he attacks or uses items. Leaving Skeleton Walk creates Skeleton Archers.

Skeleton Archers are immobile and die within multiple attacks from a hero or tower. Skeleton Archers deal a percentage of Clinkz' damage, and deal 75% less damage to buildings. Attack range is equal to Clinkz' attack range.

clinkz_infernal_shred.name: Infernal Shred
clinkz_infernal_shred.desc:
Clinkz and his skeletons apply a stacking debuff that causes their attacks to pierce up to 20% of the target's total physical armor (does not reduce their armor). Clinkz applies 3% per attack, and skeletons apply 1%. 

Lasts 5 seconds.

clinkz_bone_and_arrow.name: Bone and Arrow
clinkz_bone_and_arrow.desc: Clinkz summons a Skeleton Archer when he dies.

clinkz_tar_bomb.name: Tar Bomb
clinkz_tar_bomb.desc:
Clinkz throws a projectile filled with tar at the target enemy, dealing Magic damage on impact. After impact, the tar spills onto the ground and stays there for 5 seconds. Any enemy that walks across it gets slowed, and attacks from Clinkz or his Skeleton Archers will deal bonus physical damage.

 When the Tar Bomb hits, any Skeleton Archers within attack range will attack the target. If autocast is activated, Clinkz will throw a tar bomb when attacking the target, if it is available.

crystal_maiden_crystal_nova.name: Crystal Nova
crystal_maiden_crystal_nova.desc: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.

crystal_maiden_frostbite.name: Frostbite
crystal_maiden_frostbite.desc: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Deals 4x damage to non-ancient creeps.

crystal_maiden_brilliance_aura.name: Arcane Aura
crystal_maiden_brilliance_aura.desc:
Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a 1200 radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration.

Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.

crystal_maiden_crystal_clone.name: Crystal Clone
crystal_maiden_crystal_clone.desc: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a 450 AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.

crystal_maiden_glacial_guard.name: Glacial Guard
crystal_maiden_glacial_guard.desc: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.

crystal_maiden_freezing_field.name: Freezing Field
crystal_maiden_freezing_field.desc: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with 100 random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts 10 seconds.

dark_seer_vacuum.name: Vacuum
dark_seer_vacuum.desc: Dark Seer creates a vacuum over the target area that sucks in enemy units, disrupting them and dealing damage.

dark_seer_ion_shell.name: Ion Shell
dark_seer_ion_shell.desc: Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield that damages enemy units in an area around it.

dark_seer_surge.name: Surge
dark_seer_surge.desc: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.

dark_seer_normal_punch.name: Normal Punch
dark_seer_normal_punch.desc: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past 3 seconds. Max power is reached after 1100 distance moved.

dark_seer_aggrandize.name: Quick Wit
dark_seer_aggrandize.desc:
Dark Seer gains 1 Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.

dark_seer_wall_of_replica.name: Wall of Replica
dark_seer_wall_of_replica.desc: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.

dark_seer_quick_wit.name: Quick Wit
dark_seer_quick_wit.desc: Dark Seer gains 1 Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

dark_seer_heart_of_battle.name: Heart of Battle
dark_seer_heart_of_battle.desc: Dark Seer moves faster when near other heroes.

dark_seer_mental_fortitude.name: Mental Fortitude
dark_seer_mental_fortitude.desc: Dark Seer's Intelligence cannot be lower than the average of his Strength and Agility.

dark_willow_bramble_maze.name: Bramble Maze
dark_willow_bramble_maze.desc: Dark Willow creates a 500 AoE maze of 8 brambles that grow in the target area after 0.3 seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts 12 seconds.

dark_willow_shadow_realm.name: Shadow Realm
dark_willow_shadow_realm.desc: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable. Her next attack has 600 bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after 3 seconds.

dark_willow_cursed_crown.name: Cursed Crown
dark_willow_cursed_crown.desc: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.

dark_willow_bedlam.name: Bedlam
dark_willow_bedlam.desc: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies. Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.

dark_willow_pixie_dust.name: Pixie Dust
dark_willow_pixie_dust.desc: Dark Willow gains 20% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to 100% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.

dark_willow_terrorize.name: Terrorize
dark_willow_terrorize.desc: Dark Willow releases her pet wisp to terrorize her enemies. After a short delay, all enemies in the target area become fearful and run toward their home fountain. Terrorize cannot be used while Bedlam is active.

dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.name: Starbreaker
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.desc: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.

dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.name: Celestial Hammer
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.desc: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for 2 seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.

dawnbreaker_converge.name: Converge
dawnbreaker_converge.desc: Dawnbreaker recalls her hammer, pulling them together so they meet in the middle.

dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn.name: Break of Dawn
dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn.desc: Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day. If Dawnbreaker causes the day these bonuses are at full power for the entirety of that daytime.

dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.name: Solar Guardian
dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.desc:
CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within 350 units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for 6s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.

After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.

Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.

dazzle_poison_touch.name: Poison Touch
dazzle_poison_touch.desc: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.

dazzle_shallow_grave.name: Shallow Grave
dazzle_shallow_grave.desc: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.

dazzle_shadow_wave.name: Shadow Wave
dazzle_shadow_wave.desc: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby. Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.

dazzle_innate_weave.name: Weave
dazzle_innate_weave.desc: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.

dazzle_nothl_projection.name: Nothl Projection
dazzle_nothl_projection.desc: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.

dazzle_nothl_projection_end.name: End Projection
dazzle_nothl_projection_end.desc: Ends Dazzle's sojourn in the Nothl Realm and returns his spirit to his body.

death_prophet_carrion_swarm.name: Crypt Swarm
death_prophet_carrion_swarm.desc: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.

death_prophet_silence.name: Silence
death_prophet_silence.desc: Fires a projectile that prevents enemy units in a target area from casting spells.

death_prophet_spirit_siphon.name: Spirit Siphon
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.desc: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.

death_prophet_exorcism.name: Exorcism
death_prophet_exorcism.desc: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts 40 seconds.

death_prophet_spirit_collector.name: Spirit Collector
death_prophet_spirit_collector.desc: Hero deaths empower your next Exorcism.

disruptor_thunder_strike.name: Thunder Strike
disruptor_thunder_strike.desc: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning. Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by 100% for x1.75 seconds. Provides vision of its target.

disruptor_glimpse.name: Glimpse
disruptor_glimpse.desc: Teleports the target hero back to where it was 4 seconds ago. Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.

disruptor_kinetic_field.name: Kinetic Field
disruptor_kinetic_field.desc: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.

disruptor_kinetic_fence.name: Kinetic Fence
disruptor_kinetic_fence.desc: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.

disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion.name: Electromagnetic Repulsion
disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion.desc: Whenever Disruptor takes more than 250 damage from any source within 400 radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to 1.5x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a 400 distance away.

disruptor_static_storm.name: Static Storm
disruptor_static_storm.desc: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration. The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.

doom_bringer_devour.name: Devour
doom_bringer_devour.desc: Consumes an enemy or neutral creep, acquiring any special abilities that it possessed. If alt-cast is activated, Doom will not acquire the creep's abilities. Duration is equal to the cooldown.

doom_bringer_scorched_earth.name: Scorched Earth
doom_bringer_scorched_earth.desc: Carpets the nearby earth in flames which damage enemies, while also granting Doom increased movement speed and health regeneration.

doom_bringer_infernal_blade.name: Infernal Blade
doom_bringer_infernal_blade.desc: Doom swings his burning sword, igniting the enemy. Stuns for 0.66 seconds and applies a 4 second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second.

doom_bringer_empty1.name: Devoured Ability
doom_bringer_empty1.desc: This slot will be replaced with abilities acquired using Devour.

doom_bringer_empty2.name: Devoured Ability
doom_bringer_empty2.desc: This slot will be replaced with abilities acquired using Devour.

doom_bringer_doom.name: Doom
doom_bringer_doom.desc:
Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

doom_bringer_lvl_pain.name: Lvl ? Pain
doom_bringer_lvl_pain.desc: Doom's attacks curse enemy heroes. After 2.5s, the cursed hero bursts with a pillar of fire, damaging itself and all units in a 66 AoE for 15% of the damage taken from Doom during the curse. The damage and radius of the curse is 66% stronger if the enemy's level is a multiple of 6.

dragon_knight_breathe_fire.name: Breathe Fire
dragon_knight_breathe_fire.desc: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.

dragon_knight_dragon_tail.name: Dragon Tail
dragon_knight_dragon_tail.desc: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.

dragon_knight_wyrms_wrath.name: Wyrm's Wrath
dragon_knight_wyrms_wrath.desc: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.

dragon_knight_fireball.name: Fireball
dragon_knight_fireball.desc: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.

dragon_knight_dragon_blood.name: Dragon Blood
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.desc:
The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor. 

Regen and armor are increased by 50% during Elder Dragon Form.

dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.name: Elder Dragon Form
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.desc:
Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties. The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative. 

Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.

Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.

Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.

drow_ranger_frost_arrows.name: Frost Arrows
drow_ranger_frost_arrows.desc: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage. Slow lasts 1.5 seconds.

drow_ranger_wave_of_silence.name: Gust
drow_ranger_wave_of_silence.desc: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back and reveals invisible enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow.

drow_ranger_multishot.name: Multishot
drow_ranger_multishot.desc:
CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows. Lasts up to 1.75 seconds.

Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.

drow_ranger_glacier.name: Glacier
drow_ranger_glacier.desc:
Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.

The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.

drow_ranger_trueshot.name: Precision Aura
drow_ranger_trueshot.desc: Grants Drow bonus agility based on Drow's current agility and level. Nearby ranged heroes received 50% of the bonus agility.

drow_ranger_marksmanship.name: Marksmanship
drow_ranger_marksmanship.desc: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within 325 range.

earth_spirit_boulder_smash.name: Boulder Smash
earth_spirit_boulder_smash.desc: Earth Spirit smashes the target enemy or ally, sending them in the direction he is facing. If Earth Spirit targets an area, he will smash the nearest unit in a 200 radius, prioritizing Stone Remnants. The travelling unit or Remnant damages all enemy units it hits. If an enemy is hit by a Stone Remnant, they are also slowed. Stone Remnants travel further than other units.

earth_spirit_rolling_boulder.name: Rolling Boulder
earth_spirit_rolling_boulder.desc: Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a 0.6s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing 60 + 100% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.

earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip.name: Geomagnetic Grip
earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip.desc:
Earth Spirit pulls the target Stone Remnant or Allied Unit. Enemies struck by the gripped target will be silenced.

Pulled Remnants also deal damage to struck enemies.

Cast range is reduced when targeting an ally.

earth_spirit_stone_caller.name: Stone Remnant
earth_spirit_stone_caller.desc:
Call a Stone Remnant to the target location. Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities. Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has 7 charges.

Earth Spirit passively gains 2.5% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional 7.5% bonus damage for 10s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).

earth_spirit_petrify.name: Enchant Remnant
earth_spirit_petrify.desc:
Earth Spirit temporarily enchants a hero, granting them the properties of a Stone Remnant. After a short duration the remnant shatters, releasing the hero and damaging nearby enemies. 
Can be cast on Stone Remnants. Has a 5 second cooldown when used that way.
Has a larger cast range when cast on an ally hero.

earth_spirit_magnetize.name: Magnetize
earth_spirit_magnetize.desc: Magnetizes units in a small nearby area, causing them to take damage for a short duration. Magnetized heroes cause nearby Stone Remnants to explode, destroying the remnant and refreshing Magnetize's duration on all nearby enemies. This process can repeat multiple times. If an enemy hero is affected by Geomagnetic Grip or Boulder Smash, all magnetized heroes share the effects.

earthshaker_fissure.name: Fissure
earthshaker_fissure.desc: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.

earthshaker_enchant_totem.name: Enchant Totem
earthshaker_enchant_totem.desc: Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have 100 bonus attack range on the next attack.

earthshaker_aftershock.name: Aftershock
earthshaker_aftershock.desc: Causes the earth to shake underfoot, adding additional damage and stuns to nearby enemy units when Earthshaker casts his abilities.

earthshaker_echo_slam.name: Echo Slam
earthshaker_echo_slam.desc: Shockwaves travel through the ground, damaging enemy units. Each enemy hit causes an echo to damage nearby units. Real heroes cause two echoes.

earthshaker_slugger.name: Slugger
earthshaker_slugger.desc: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.

earthshaker_spirit_cairn.name: Spirit Cairn
earthshaker_spirit_cairn.desc: When Earthshaker dies, a 75 radius fissure is created where he died. This fissure blocks movement and allows Earthshaker to continue to gain experience around it. It remains until Earthshaker respawns.

elder_titan_echo_stomp.name: Echo Stomp
elder_titan_echo_stomp.desc: CHANNELED - Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations. The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.

elder_titan_ancestral_spirit.name: Astral Spirit
elder_titan_ancestral_spirit.desc:
Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through. When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through.

The Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.

elder_titan_natural_order.name: Natural Order
elder_titan_natural_order.desc: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.

elder_titan_move_spirit.name: Move Astral Spirit
elder_titan_move_spirit.desc: Moves the Astral Spirit to target location.

elder_titan_momentum.name: Momentum
elder_titan_momentum.desc: Elder Titan gains armor equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed.

elder_titan_earth_splitter.name: Earth Splitter
elder_titan_earth_splitter.desc: Sends forth a jagged crack in front of Elder Titan. After 3 seconds, the crack implodes, slowing movement while dealing damage to each enemy based on their maximum life. Half of the damage dealt is Magical damage, while the other half is Physical damage.

elder_titan_return_spirit.name: Return Astral Spirit
elder_titan_return_spirit.desc: Returns the Astral Spirit to Elder Titan.

elder_titan_echo_stomp_spirit.name: Echo Stomp
elder_titan_echo_stomp_spirit.desc: Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations. The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage. Unconscious enemies will wake if they take damage.

elder_titan_natural_order_spirit.name: Natural Order
elder_titan_natural_order_spirit.desc: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.

elder_titan_tip_the_scales.name: Tip the Scales
elder_titan_tip_the_scales.desc: Allied creeps and buildings affected by Glyph of Fortification or Roshan's Banner deal 100% bonus damage.

ember_spirit_searing_chains.name: Searing Chains
ember_spirit_searing_chains.desc: Ember Spirit unleashes fiery bolas that wrap around nearby enemies, anchoring them in place and dealing damage each second.

ember_spirit_sleight_of_fist.name: Sleight of Fist
ember_spirit_sleight_of_fist.desc: Ember Spirit dashes around with blazing speed, attacking all enemies in the targeted area of effect, then returning to his start location. Deals bonus damage to heroes.

ember_spirit_flame_guard.name: Flame Guard
ember_spirit_flame_guard.desc: Ember Spirit surrounds himself with a ring of fire that consumes incoming magic damage, absorbing a percentage of the damage taken. Flame Guard deals damage per second in an area around Ember Spirit while Flame Guard is active. If the shield is broken, the damage is also lost.

ember_spirit_activate_fire_remnant.name: Activate Fire Remnant
ember_spirit_activate_fire_remnant.desc: Select the Fire Remnant to arrive at.

ember_spirit_immolation.name: Immolation
ember_spirit_immolation.desc: Ember Spirit is continuously burning, dealing damage per second to all nearby enemies at all times.

ember_spirit_fire_remnant.name: Fire Remnant
ember_spirit_fire_remnant.desc: Sends a Fire Remnant that runs to the target location at 250% Ember Spirit's speed. Using Activate Fire Remnant, Ember Spirit will dash out to all active Fire Remnants, destroying them and dealing damage in an area and then moving to the nearest Remnant. Ember Spirit will end at the Remnant closest to the targeted location.

enchantress_impetus.name: Impetus
enchantress_impetus.desc: Places an enchantment on each attack while activated, causing it to deal additional damage based on how far away the target is. The farther the target, the greater the damage dealt. Deals double damage to illusions.

enchantress_enchant.name: Enchant
enchantress_enchant.desc:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for 3.5s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives 40% of their experience bounty. Enchantress can control creeps for up to 30s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

enchantress_natures_attendants.name: Nature's Attendants
enchantress_natures_attendants.desc: A cloud of wisps heals Enchantress and any friendly units nearby.

enchantress_bunny_hop.name: Sproink
enchantress_bunny_hop.desc: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the 2 furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + 100.

enchantress_little_friends.name: Little Friends
enchantress_little_friends.desc: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for 6 seconds.

enchantress_untouchable.name: Untouchable
enchantress_untouchable.desc: Enchantress beguiles her enemies, slowing their attacks when she is attacked.

enchantress_rabblerouser.name: Rabble-Rouser
enchantress_rabblerouser.desc: Enchantress causes neutral creeps or any unit under her control to deal additional damage to enemy Heroes.

enigma_malefice.name: Malefice
enigma_malefice.desc: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances. An instance strikes every 2 seconds.

enigma_demonic_conversion.name: Demonic Summoning
enigma_demonic_conversion.desc: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health. The eidolons health is increased by 3% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply. When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.

enigma_midnight_pulse.name: Midnight Pulse
enigma_midnight_pulse.desc: Steeps an area in dark resonance, dealing 5 + a percentage of the enemies current HP as damage.

enigma_event_horizon.name: Event Horizon
enigma_event_horizon.desc: Units in a 600 radius moving away from Enigma have a movespeed penalty.

enigma_black_hole.name: Black Hole
enigma_black_hole.desc: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units. Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.

enigma_gravity_well.name: Gravity Well
enigma_gravity_well.desc: Allies within 500 distance from Enigma have up to 9% Damage Reduction. Effect starts at 0% at max distance and increases to its maximum strength when the ally is at 200 distance. Does not affect Enigma itself.

enigma_splitting_image.name: Splitting Image
enigma_splitting_image.desc: Enigma spawns Eidolons upon receiving damage.

faceless_void_time_walk.name: Time Walk
faceless_void_time_walk.desc: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last 2 seconds.

faceless_void_time_dilation.name: Time Dilation
faceless_void_time_dilation.desc: Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.

faceless_void_time_lock.name: Time Lock
faceless_void_time_lock.desc: Adds the chance for an attack to lock an enemy unit in time while attacking it a second time.

faceless_void_time_walk_reverse.name: Reverse Time Walk
faceless_void_time_walk_reverse.desc: Available for 1.5 seconds after landing Time Walk. If used in this period, you will reverse your time walk back to your previous cast location. Does not affect health or proc scepter hits.

faceless_void_distortion_field.name: Distortion Field
faceless_void_distortion_field.desc: Enemy Attack Projectiles targetting Faceless Void or allied heroes within a 1200 radius of him get slowed by 40%, when they get within 500 distance of their target.

faceless_void_chronosphere.name: Chronosphere
faceless_void_chronosphere.desc: Creates a blister in spacetime, trapping all units caught in its sphere of influence and causes you to move very quickly inside it. Only Faceless Void and any units he controls are unaffected. Invisible enemies in the sphere will be revealed.

faceless_void_time_zone.name: Time Zone
faceless_void_time_zone.desc: Creates a blister in spacetime, altering the movement, cast, projectile, cooldown, and turn rate speed of all units inside. Allies have increased speed and cooldown acceleration. Enemies have decreased speed, and have frozen ability and item cooldowns. Does not affect Ultimate abilities. Time Dilation does not tick down while inside.

furion_sprout.name: Sprout
furion_sprout.desc: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, damaging and trapping it in place and providing vision in a 400 radius.

furion_teleportation.name: Teleportation
furion_teleportation.desc: Teleports to any point on the map. Gains a barrier after arriving to its destination.

furion_force_of_nature.name: Nature's Call
furion_force_of_nature.desc: Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.

furion_curse_of_the_forest.name: Curse of the Oldgrowth
furion_curse_of_the_forest.desc: Applies a curse on all enemy heroes within 900 range, displaying them in fog, slowing them, and dealing damage over time based on the number of trees within 250 radius. Treants count as trees for this purpose.

furion_spirit_of_the_forest.name: Spirit of the Forest
furion_spirit_of_the_forest.desc: Nature's Prophet gains 2% bonus damage for each nearby tree. Treants also provide this bonus with multiplied values and with larger radius. Treants also possess this ability.

furion_wrath_of_nature.name: Wrath of Nature
furion_wrath_of_nature.desc: Damaging energy bounces around the map, striking enemies that are in vision starting with those closest to the cast point. Each enemy hit beyond the first adds damage, up to the maximum after 16 are hit.

grimstroke_dark_artistry.name: Stroke of Fate
grimstroke_dark_artistry.desc:
Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits.

 Can be put on alt-cast to have the path be straight.

grimstroke_ink_creature.name: Phantom's Embrace
grimstroke_ink_creature.desc:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.

grimstroke_spirit_walk.name: Ink Swell
grimstroke_spirit_walk.desc: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After 3 seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.

grimstroke_soul_chain.name: Soulbind
grimstroke_soul_chain.desc: Binds a targeted enemy hero to its nearest allied hero within the bind radius, preventing both from moving away from each other. Any unit-targeted ability that either bound hero receives also gets cast on the other hero. If the bind is broken before the duration expires, the initial target will be bound to its nearest allied hero in the radius.

grimstroke_ink_trail.name: Ink Trail
grimstroke_ink_trail.desc: Grimstroke's attacks and spells cause affected enemy heroes to leave a trail of Ink behind them and deal less damage to Grimstroke for 4s.

gyrocopter_rocket_barrage.name: Rocket Barrage
gyrocopter_rocket_barrage.desc: Launches a salvo of rockets at nearby enemy units in a radius around the Gyrocopter. Lasts 3 seconds.

gyrocopter_homing_missile.name: Homing Missile
gyrocopter_homing_missile.desc: Fires a homing missile to seek the targeted enemy unit. The missile gains speed over time, dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target. Enemy units can destroy the missile before it reaches its target.

gyrocopter_flak_cannon.name: Flak Cannon
gyrocopter_flak_cannon.desc: Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks. Only the main target of attacks will receive attack bonuses such as Critical Strike. Lasts 12 seconds or until the attacks are used.

gyrocopter_afterburner.name: Afterburner
gyrocopter_afterburner.desc: Gyrocopter gains movement speed for a short duration after damaging an enemy with his attacks or abilities.

gyrocopter_call_down.name: Call Down
gyrocopter_call_down.desc: Call down 3 aerial missile strikes that slow and damage enemy units in a target area. Each strike is 500 distance from the previous one.

hoodwink_acorn_shot.name: Acorn Shot
hoodwink_acorn_shot.desc:
Fires Hoodwink's attack with an acorn at the target unit. The acorn bounces to nearby targets, slowing them and dealing a percentage of Hoodwink's attack with bonus damage.
If point targeted, a tree is created at the target position and the acorn will bounce to nearby targets. The ability may be placed on alt-cast to force this behavior.

hoodwink_bushwhack.name: Bushwhack
hoodwink_bushwhack.desc: Tosses a net trap that stuns enemies if they are near a tree in the area. Affected enemies take damage over time and are pulled towards the tree nearest to them within the target area, and have their vision reduced to 0 for the duration of the stun.

hoodwink_scurry.name: Scurry
hoodwink_scurry.desc: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time. While active, the redirect chance of Mistwoods Wayfarer is multiplied by 2.

hoodwink_decoy.name: Decoy
hoodwink_decoy.desc: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.

hoodwink_hunters_boomerang.name: Hunter's Boomerang
hoodwink_hunters_boomerang.desc: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink. The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.

hoodwink_sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
hoodwink_sharpshooter.desc:
Hoodwink charges up and fires a deadly bolt from her crossbow, dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero. The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after x0.75 seconds, and the bolt is fired automatically after x0.75 seconds.
Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of 350 from the force of the shot. Creeps hit by the bolt are damaged for half the values.

hoodwink_sharpshooter_release.name: End Sharpshooter
hoodwink_sharpshooter_release.desc: Release the charged up shot, regain ability to move and attack.

hoodwink_tomokan_tracker.name: Tomo'kan Tracker
hoodwink_tomokan_tracker.desc: Hoodwink can see footprints of where enemy Heroes have been in the last 15 seconds in a 1200 area around her.

huskar_inner_fire.name: Inner Fire
huskar_inner_fire.desc: In a fiery rage, knocks all nearby enemies away from you to a fixed distance, dealing damage and silencing them.

huskar_burning_spear.name: Burning Spear
huskar_burning_spear.desc: Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack. Multiple attacks will stack additional damage. Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.

huskar_berserkers_blood.name: Berserker's Blood
huskar_berserkers_blood.desc: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.

huskar_blood_magic.name: Blood Magic
huskar_blood_magic.desc: Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.

huskar_life_break.name: Life Break
huskar_life_break.desc:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed. While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with 60% magic resistance.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

invoker_quas.name: Quas
invoker_quas.desc: Allows manipulation of ice elements. Active Quas instances imbue Invoker with bonus hp regeneration. Passively grants bonus strength per level of Quas.

invoker_wex.name: Wex
invoker_wex.desc: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active Wex instances imbue Invoker with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of Wex.

invoker_exort.name: Exort
invoker_exort.desc: Allows manipulation of fire elements. Active Exort instances imbue Invoker with bonus attack damage. Passively grants bonus intelligence per level of Exort.

invoker_empty1.name: Invoked Spell
invoker_empty1.desc: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active Quas, Wex, and Exort buffs.

invoker_empty2.name: Invoked Spell
invoker_empty2.desc: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active Quas, Wex, and Exort buffs.

invoker_invoke.name: Invoke
invoker_invoke.desc:
Combines the properties of the elements currently being manipulated to create a new spell for Invoker to use. Invoke cooldown is reduced by 0.3 seconds for each orb level.

Invoker's vast knowledge of magic allows him to choose from Multiple Aghanim's Scepter and Shard options. The items must be activated before they can be used, and cannot be changed after they are chosen.

 Click the help button to see the list of possible spells.

invoker_cold_snap.name: Cold Snap
invoker_cold_snap.desc: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of Quas. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of Quas.

invoker_ghost_walk.name: Ghost Walk
invoker_ghost_walk.desc: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of Wex.

invoker_tornado.name: Tornado
invoker_tornado.desc:
Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of Wex. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of Quas. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in Wex.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

invoker_emp.name: E.M.P.
invoker_emp.desc: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after 2.9 seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of Wex. Deals damage for each point of mana drained. If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 25% of the mana drained.

invoker_alacrity.name: Alacrity
invoker_alacrity.desc: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed based on the level of Wex and their damage based on the level of Exort.

invoker_chaos_meteor.name: Chaos Meteor
invoker_chaos_meteor.desc: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of Exort, and rolling further based on the level of Wex. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of Exort.

invoker_sun_strike.name: Sun Strike
invoker_sun_strike.desc: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of Exort, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.

invoker_forge_spirit.name: Forge Spirit
invoker_forge_spirit.desc: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of Exort while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of Quas. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. The number of spirits spawned is determined by the lower level of Quas and Exort.

invoker_ice_wall.name: Ice Wall
invoker_ice_wall.desc: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of Quas. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas and deals damage each second based on the level of Exort.

invoker_deafening_blast.name: Deafening Blast
invoker_deafening_blast.desc: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of Exort. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of Quas, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of Wex.

invoker_attribute_bonus.name: Attribute Bonus
invoker_attribute_bonus.desc: Improves all attributes per point spent

invoker_cold_snap_ad.name: Cold Snap (AD)
invoker_cold_snap_ad.desc: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases as the level goes up.

invoker_ghost_walk_ad.name: Ghost Walk (AD)
invoker_ghost_walk_ad.desc: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies, and slows Invoker as well based on the level.

invoker_tornado_ad.name: Tornado (AD)
invoker_tornado_ad.desc:
Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level and holds enemies in the air for a duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

invoker_emp_ad.name: E.M.P. (AD)
invoker_emp_ad.desc: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after 2.9 seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana. Deals damage for each point of mana drained. If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 50% of the mana drained.

invoker_alacrity_ad.name: Alacrity (AD)
invoker_alacrity_ad.desc: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed and their damage.

invoker_chaos_meteor_ad.name: Chaos Meteor (AD)
invoker_chaos_meteor_ad.desc: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage and rolling further based on the level. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time.

invoker_sun_strike_ad.name: Sun Strike (AD)
invoker_sun_strike_ad.desc: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.

invoker_forge_spirit_ad.name: Forge Spirit (AD)
invoker_forge_spirit_ad.desc: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes.

invoker_ice_wall_ad.name: Ice Wall (AD)
invoker_ice_wall_ad.desc: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies and deals damage each second.

invoker_deafening_blast_ad.name: Deafening Blast
invoker_deafening_blast_ad.desc: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration then disarm their attacks for a duration.

invoker_mastermind.name: Mastermind
invoker_mastermind.desc: When Invoker denies a lane creep, he gets 25% of the XP.

jakiro_dual_breath.name: Dual Breath
jakiro_dual_breath.desc: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.

jakiro_ice_path.name: Ice Path
jakiro_ice_path.desc: Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.

jakiro_liquid_fire.name: Liquid Fire
jakiro_liquid_fire.desc: Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.

jakiro_liquid_ice.name: Liquid Frost
jakiro_liquid_ice.desc: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for 5 seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.

jakiro_double_trouble.name: Double Trouble
jakiro_double_trouble.desc: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.

jakiro_macropyre.name: Macropyre
jakiro_macropyre.desc: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.

jakiro_ice_path_detonate.name: Destroy Ice Path
jakiro_ice_path_detonate.desc: Destroy the Ice Path, dealing damage and stunning enemies.

juggernaut_blade_fury.name: Blade Fury
juggernaut_blade_fury.desc: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with 80% magic resistance and dealing damage every 0.2s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.

juggernaut_healing_ward.name: Healing Ward
juggernaut_healing_ward.desc: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health. The Healing Ward moves at 325 movement speed after being summoned. Lasts 18 seconds.

juggernaut_blade_dance.name: Blade Dance
juggernaut_blade_dance.desc: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.

juggernaut_swift_slash.name: Swiftslash
juggernaut_swift_slash.desc: Performs a short Omnislash for 1 seconds.

juggernaut_bladeform.name: Bladeform
juggernaut_bladeform.desc: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every 2s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after 2s upon taking any damage.

juggernaut_omni_slash.name: Omnislash
juggernaut_omni_slash.desc:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
