rubick_telekinesis_land_self.desc: Chooses the location you will land when Telekinesis finishes.

rubick_might_and_magus.name: Might and Magus
rubick_might_and_magus.desc: Rubick gains stacking bonus area of effect when he casts a spell.

sandking_burrowstrike.name: Burrowstrike
sandking_burrowstrike.desc:
Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit

 Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.

sandking_sand_storm.name: Sand Storm
sandking_sand_storm.desc: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.

sandking_scorpion_strike.name: Stinger
sandking_scorpion_strike.desc: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of 125 take 40% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.

sandking_caustic_finale.name: Caustic Finale
sandking_caustic_finale.desc: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.

sandking_epicenter.name: Epicenter
sandking_epicenter.desc: After a cast point of 2 seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.

shadow_demon_disruption.name: Disruption
shadow_demon_disruption.desc: Banishes the targeted unit from the battlefield for a short duration. Upon returning, two illusions of the banished unit with bonus base damage are created under Shadow Demon's control.

shadow_demon_disseminate.name: Disseminate
shadow_demon_disseminate.desc: Whenever the target takes damage, all enemies, including the target itself if it is an enemy, within 675 range of the target also receive a portion of that damage. Can target enemy and allied units. Effect is paused if the target is hidden by Disruption.

shadow_demon_shadow_poison.name: Shadow Poison
shadow_demon_shadow_poison.desc: Deals damage in a line, and afflicts enemy units with a poison effect. The poison deals 1/2/4/8/16 times the stack damage based on the number of stacks on the target, up to 5 stacks. Additional stacks cause 50 damage each. This deferred damage is dealt when Shadow Poison's duration is expired, or the Release sub-ability is used.

shadow_demon_shadow_poison_release.name: Shadow Poison Release
shadow_demon_shadow_poison_release.desc: Releases the poison to do damage on all affected enemies. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Shadow Poison.

shadow_demon_demonic_cleanse.name: Demonic Cleanse
shadow_demon_demonic_cleanse.desc:
Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration. At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

shadow_demon_demonic_purge.name: Demonic Purge
shadow_demon_demonic_purge.desc:
Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration. The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

shadow_demon_menace.name: Menace
shadow_demon_menace.desc: Shadow Demon's Attacks apply a stacking debuff to the enemy for 8 seconds that increases their damage taken.

shadow_demon_shadow_servant.name: Soul Catcher
shadow_demon_shadow_servant.desc:
Shadow Demon and his illusions' attacks reduce the current health of the target by 1% per stack. When the effect expires, the target regains 50% of the lost health.

If an enemy Hero dies under this effect, Shadow Demon creates an illusion of them that lasts until the Hero respawns or Shadow Demon dies.

shadow_shaman_ether_shock.name: Ether Shock
shadow_shaman_ether_shock.desc: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.

shadow_shaman_voodoo.name: Hex
shadow_shaman_voodoo.desc: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.

shadow_shaman_shackles.name: Shackles
shadow_shaman_shackles.desc: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.

shadow_shaman_fowl_play.name: Fowl Play
shadow_shaman_fowl_play.desc:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

shadow_shaman_urnaconda.name: Urnaconda
shadow_shaman_urnaconda.desc: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has 4x the base Serpent Ward damage and health there that lasts 15s.

shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward.name: Mass Serpent Ward
shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward.desc: Summons 10 Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.

shadow_shaman_voodoo_hands.name: Chicken Fingers
shadow_shaman_voodoo_hands.desc: Your next attack on an enemy hero transforms them into a chicken for 1s.

shredder_whirling_death.name: Whirling Death
shredder_whirling_death.desc: Timbersaw whirls extremely sharp edges, damaging enemies and destroying trees around him in an area. If an enemy hero is affected, it loses some of its primary attribute for a short duration. Whirling Death will deal bonus damage per tree destroyed.

shredder_timber_chain.name: Timber Chain
shredder_timber_chain.desc: Timbersaw fires a chain that embeds itself in the first tree it hits, pulling him towards it. Any enemy in the path takes damage.

shredder_reactive_armor.name: Reactive Armor
shredder_reactive_armor.desc: Each time Timbersaw is attacked, he gains increased health regen and armor. Hero attacks are counted as 4x the amount.

shredder_flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
shredder_flamethrower.desc: Releases a flame in the direction Timbersaw is facing. Applies a debuff that deals damage per second and slows enemy movement speed. Affects buildings for reduced damage.

shredder_chakram.name: Chakram
shredder_chakram.desc: Fires Timbersaw's main saw blade at the target location where it will spin in place, dealing damage in an area around it. Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every 5% of health missing. The blade deals damage and cuts down trees in its path when fired and retracted. While active the ability costs mana, and Timbersaw loses the ability to attack.

shredder_exposure_therapy.name: Exposure Therapy
shredder_exposure_therapy.desc: Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains mana.

shredder_twisted_chakram.name: Twisted Chakram
shredder_twisted_chakram.desc: Launches a second independent Chakram that follows a curved path and returns to Timbersaw, damaging and slowing enemies it passes through. Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every 5% of health missing.

silencer_curse_of_the_silent.name: Arcane Curse
silencer_curse_of_the_silent.desc:
Curses the target area, dealing damage and causing enemies to take damage over time and slowing their movement speed.

Anytime affected enemies cast a spell, the duration is increased. The duration is paused as long as the target is silenced.

silencer_glaives_of_wisdom.name: Glaives of Wisdom
silencer_glaives_of_wisdom.desc: Silencer enchants his glaives with his wisdom, stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.

silencer_last_word.name: Last Word
silencer_last_word.desc: Enchants a target, providing vision of them and causing them to be damaged and silenced if they cast a spell or if the enchantment timer expires. Deals extra damage based on the difference in intelligence between Silencer and the target.

silencer_brain_drain.name: Suffer In Silence
silencer_brain_drain.desc:
Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.

If an enemy Hero dies within 925 range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death, Silencer permanently steals 1 Intelligence from them. If the victim was silenced, steal an extra 1 Intelligence.

silencer_global_silence.name: Global Silence
silencer_global_silence.desc: Silencer stops all sound, preventing enemy heroes and units on the map from casting spells.

silencer_oppressive_silence.name: Suffer In Silence
silencer_oppressive_silence.desc: Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.

skeleton_king_hellfire_blast.name: Wraithfire Blast
skeleton_king_hellfire_blast.desc: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.

skeleton_king_bone_guard.name: Bone Guard
skeleton_king_bone_guard.desc: Gains a Charge for every 2 creeps killed and 2 charges per hero killed. Activate to spend all charges, summoning skeletons that respawn once when killed. Skeletons benefit from Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal.

skeleton_king_mortal_strike.name: Mortal Strike
skeleton_king_mortal_strike.desc: Wraith King passively deals bonus damage on an attack with a cooldown.

skeleton_king_vampiric_spirit.name: Vampiric Spirit
skeleton_king_vampiric_spirit.desc: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.

skeleton_king_reincarnation.name: Reincarnation
skeleton_king_reincarnation.desc: Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle. Upon death, enemy units in a 600 radius are slowed. Skeletons spawn and attack each nearby enemy hero. Can be self-cast to kill Wraith King instantly.

skeleton_king_spectral_blade.name: Spectral Blade
skeleton_king_spectral_blade.desc: Curses units that Wraith King attacks, dealing a flat amount of damage and a percentage of the attack damage again after a delay. Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal applies to the curse damage and a unit cannot be cursed again for a short period of time.

skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.name: Arcane Bolt
skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.desc: Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.

skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.name: Concussive Shot
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.desc: Skywrath Mage sets off a long range shot that hits the closest hero within a long range. Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.

skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.name: Ancient Seal
skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.desc: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.

skywrath_mage_shield_of_the_scion.name: Shield of the Scion
skywrath_mage_shield_of_the_scion.desc: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains a small magic damage barrier. Each buff stacks independently.

skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.name: Mystic Flare
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.desc: Skywrath Mage uses his ultimate magical ability to conjure a precise and violent mystical field that lays waste to his adversaries. Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over 2 seconds.

skywrath_mage_staff_of_the_scion.name: Staff of the Scion
skywrath_mage_staff_of_the_scion.desc: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magic damage to an enemy hero with an ability, he reduces all his ability cooldowns by 0.1s.

slardar_sprint.name: Guardian Sprint
slardar_sprint.desc: Slardar slithers ahead, moving significantly faster and passing through units. Slardar has 100% slow resistance for the first 2.5s. The slow resistance gradually fades over the remaining sprint duration.

slardar_slithereen_crush.name: Slithereen Crush
slardar_slithereen_crush.desc: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. After the stun, the affected units are slowed.

slardar_bash.name: Bash of the Deep
slardar_bash.desc: After 3 attacks, your next attack will bash the target.

slardar_seaborn_sentinel.name: Seaborn Sentinel
slardar_seaborn_sentinel.desc: Slardar gains bonus movement speed, health regeneration, attack damage, and armor while in a puddle, trail, or river.

slardar_amplify_damage.name: Corrosive Haze
slardar_amplify_damage.desc: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it.

slark_dark_pact.name: Dark Pact
slark_dark_pact.desc:
After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself. Slark only takes 30% of the damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

slark_pounce.name: Pounce
slark_pounce.desc: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.

slark_saltwater_shiv.name: Saltwater Shiv
slark_saltwater_shiv.desc:
Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.

These effects stack independently.

slark_depth_shroud.name: Depth Shroud
slark_depth_shroud.desc: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.

slark_essence_shift.name: Essence Shift
slark_essence_shift.desc: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining 1 of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus 3 Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals 1 Agility.

slark_shadow_dance.name: Shadow Dance
slark_shadow_dance.desc:
When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration. If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for 2 seconds.

When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.

snapfire_scatterblast.name: Scatterblast
snapfire_scatterblast.desc: Snapfire unloads with a wide blast that damages and slows enemies in a cone. Damage is increased by 30% and Movement Slow, Attack Slow and Slow Duration are increased by 50% for enemies caught at point-blank range.

snapfire_firesnap_cookie.name: Firesnap Cookie
snapfire_firesnap_cookie.desc: Snapfire feeds a potent cookie to Mortimer or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.

snapfire_lil_shredder.name: Lil' Shredder
snapfire_lil_shredder.desc: Snapfire heats up her mounted turret to rapidly fire 5 attacks dealing fixed damage plus a percentage of her attack damage. Each attack reduces the enemy's armor. Provides bonus attack range for the duration.

snapfire_gobble_up.name: Gobble Up
snapfire_gobble_up.desc: Mortimer gobbles up a creep or an allied hero, which he can then spit towards enemies. The unit stays in his belly up to [object Object] seconds.

snapfire_spit_creep.name: Spit Out
snapfire_spit_creep.desc: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has a no minimum launch range.

snapfire_mortimer_kisses.name: Mortimer Kisses
snapfire_mortimer_kisses.desc: Snapfire's friend launches a barrage of firespit globs over 5.5 seconds. Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time. Snapfire has a reduced turn rate for the duration and a minimum launch range of 600. Each glob can be targeted with a right click.

snapfire_boomstick.name: Boomstick
snapfire_boomstick.desc: Snapfire deals more damage to nearby enemies.

snapfire_buckshot.name: Buckshot
snapfire_buckshot.desc: When attacking enemy heroes, Snapfire deals 30% more damage with her auto attacks, but has a 25% chance of a glancing shot, dealing 60% damage.

sniper_shrapnel.name: Shrapnel
sniper_shrapnel.desc: Consumes a charge to launch a ball of shrapnel that showers the target area in explosive pellets. Enemies are subject to damage and slowed movement. Reveals the targeted area. Shrapnel charges restore every 35 seconds.

sniper_headshot.name: Headshot
sniper_headshot.desc: Sniper increases his accuracy, giving him a chance to deal 20 extra damage and knock back his enemies. Knockback distance increases based on how close the enemy is to Sniper. Headshots briefly slow enemy movement and attack speed by -100%.

sniper_take_aim.name: Take Aim
sniper_take_aim.desc:
Passively increases Sniper's attack range by 160.

On cast, Sniper gains increased vision, Headshot chance, and attack range. Slows you by 65% for the duration and restricts your vision to a frontal cone.

sniper_concussive_grenade.name: Concussive Grenade
sniper_concussive_grenade.desc: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.

sniper_keen_scope.name: Keen Scope
sniper_keen_scope.desc: Sniper’s attacks deal bonus damage for every 100 units of distance Sniper is from the target.

sniper_assassinate.name: Assassinate
sniper_assassinate.desc: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.

spectre_spectral_dagger.name: Spectral Dagger
spectre_spectral_dagger.desc: Spectre flings a dagger to draw a Shadow Path, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail. Units hit by the dagger also trail a Shadow Path. While treading the path, Spectre moves faster and phases through otherwise impassable terrain.

spectre_shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
spectre_shadow_step.desc:
Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.

spectre_dispersion.name: Dispersion
spectre_dispersion.desc: Spectre disperses part of the damage dealt to her, reflecting it to all nearby enemies. The effect lessens with distance.

spectre_reality.name: Reality
spectre_reality.desc: Spectre assumes the target Shadow Step or Haunt illusion, destroying it.

spectre_desolate.name: Desolate
spectre_desolate.desc: Spectre and her illusions deal bonus Pure damage if attacking an enemy that does not have any allied units within a 350 radius around them.

spectre_haunt.name: Haunt
spectre_haunt.desc:
Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes.

Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself. They ignore terrain.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.

spectre_spectral.name: Spectral
spectre_spectral.desc:
When targeting a unit for attack, Spectre gains phased collision. If she moves through a unit, she gains 40 movement speed. This effect lingers for 0.3s.

Spectre's illusions always have phased collision, and cannot gain the speed bonus.

spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.name: Charge of Darkness
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.desc:
Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at 25% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after 1.5s.

All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash. If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.

spirit_breaker_bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
spirit_breaker_bulldoze.desc: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.

spirit_breaker_greater_bash.name: Greater Bash
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.desc: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.

spirit_breaker_planar_pocket.name: Planar Pocket
spirit_breaker_planar_pocket.desc: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.

spirit_breaker_bull_rush.name: Empowering Haste
spirit_breaker_bull_rush.desc: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.

spirit_breaker_nether_strike.name: Nether Strike
spirit_breaker_nether_strike.desc: Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim. Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of the current level occurs and deals bonus damage. Knocks back for double the normal distance.

spirit_breaker_herd_mentality.name: Herd Mentality
spirit_breaker_herd_mentality.desc: The hero on your team whose level is lower than anybody else's on your team gains 50% more experience.

storm_spirit_static_remnant.name: Static Remnant
storm_spirit_static_remnant.desc: Creates an explosively charged image of Storm Spirit that walks to the target position and lasts for 12 seconds. Will detonate and deal damage if an enemy unit comes near it.

storm_spirit_electric_vortex.name: Electric Vortex
storm_spirit_electric_vortex.desc: A vortex that pulls an enemy unit to Storm Spirit's location.

storm_spirit_overload.name: Overload
storm_spirit_overload.desc: Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.

storm_spirit_ball_lightning.name: Ball Lightning
storm_spirit_ball_lightning.desc: Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is 25+7.5% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is 10+0.65% of his total mana pool. Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.

storm_spirit_galvanized.name: Galvanized
storm_spirit_galvanized.desc: Storm Spirit gains a charge of 0.2 mana regeneration per kill. Loses 2 charges per death. Additionally every time he gains a charge he also gains 0.1 Mana Regen permanently.

storm_spirit_electric_rave.name: Electric Rave
storm_spirit_electric_rave.desc: Grants Storm Spirit and allied heroes within 750 AoE of him 3 Overload charges. Provides 40 Attack Speed. Lasts up to 12 seconds or until the charges are depleted.

sven_storm_bolt.name: Storm Hammer
sven_storm_bolt.desc: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.

sven_great_cleave.name: Great Cleave
sven_great_cleave.desc: Sven strikes with great force, cleaving all nearby enemy units with his attack.

sven_warcry.name: Warcry
sven_warcry.desc: Sven's Warcry heartens his allied heroes for battle, increasing their armor and movement speed. Lasts 8 seconds.

sven_gods_strength.name: God's Strength
sven_gods_strength.desc: Sven channels his rogue strength, granting bonus damage and slow resistance for 30 seconds.

sven_wrath_of_god.name: Wrath of God
sven_wrath_of_god.desc: Sven gains additional attack damage from Strength.

sven_vanquisher.name: Vanquisher
sven_vanquisher.desc: Sven's attacks deal 20% bonus damage to stunned enemies.

techies_sticky_bomb.name: Sticky Bomb
techies_sticky_bomb.desc: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for 3 seconds.

techies_reactive_tazer.name: Reactive Tazer
techies_reactive_tazer.desc:
Techies trigger an electric charge on the target ally, giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.

At the end of the effect or if detonated early with the sub-ability, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius and dealing damage.

techies_suicide.name: Blast Off!
techies_suicide.desc: Techies hurtle themselves into the enemy's midst, detonating charges upon impact which deal massive area of effect damage and stun enemies. Upon landing, the assault deals Techies non-lethal damage equal to a percentage of their current health.

techies_mutually_assured_destruction.name: M.A.D.
techies_mutually_assured_destruction.desc:
Techies gain a percentage of their mana pool as bonus mana regeneration.

When Techies die, they leave behind a barrel that explodes after 1.5s, damaging enemies in an area around it. Damage is based on Techies' max mana.

techies_minefield_sign.name: Minefield Sign
techies_minefield_sign.desc:
Plant a warning sign, causing Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal 15% more damage. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts 240 seconds.

When an enemy Hero walks within 200 units of a minefield sign, the 1000 units area around the sign will become a minefield for 10 seconds, dealing damage to enemy Heroes any time they move within its area. Minefield Sign is destroyed after this effect ends.

techies_land_mines.name: Proximity Mines
techies_land_mines.desc: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active 500 AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for 1 seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within 150 radius and decreases up to 60% on the edge. Deals 30% damage to buildings.

techies_snare_trap.name: Snare Trap
techies_snare_trap.desc: Plant an invisible trap that, when triggered by a player-controlled target, does a small amount of damage over time and slows enemy cast speed. Affected units are also tethered inside of the trap radius. Snare Traps take 2 seconds to activate and last for up to 300 seconds.

techies_stasis_trap.name: Stasis Trap
techies_stasis_trap.desc: Plant an invisible trap that roots nearby enemy units instantly when triggered.

techies_remote_mines.name: Remote Mines
techies_remote_mines.desc: Plant an invisible explosive that will only detonate after a brief delay when triggered. Does not damage buildings.

techies_squees_scope.name: Squee's Scope
techies_squees_scope.desc: Techies gains 1 attack range and attack projectile speed for each point of attack speed.

techies_spoons_stash.name: Spoon's Stash
techies_spoons_stash.desc: Techies stack all previously selected Enchantments onto newly crafted Neutral Items.

templar_assassin_refraction.name: Refraction
templar_assassin_refraction.desc: Templar Assassin becomes highly elusive, gaining a small barrier and bonus to her damage. The damage and avoidance effects are separate, and have a limited number of instances. If a barrier is consumed, a new one is created as long as there are charges left. If an instance of damage would deal more damage than the remaining barrier, all of the damage is absorbed.

templar_assassin_meld.name: Meld
templar_assassin_meld.desc: Templar Assassin conceals herself, becoming invisible as long as she remains still. If Meld's invisibility is broken by attacking an enemy, Lanaya's attack will deal bonus damage to the enemy and reduce their armor for 6 seconds. Bonus damage and armor reductions are applied to all enemies in the Psi Blades split range.

templar_assassin_psi_blades.name: Psi Blades
templar_assassin_psi_blades.desc: Templar Assassin's psi blades slice through the attacked unit, splitting and damaging enemy units directly behind it, while gaining bonus attack range. For each unit it damages, the split damage is reduced by a percentage.

templar_assassin_trap.name: Trap
templar_assassin_trap.desc:
Springs the trap nearest to Templar Assassin, slowing nearby enemies. 

If the ability is in alt-cast state, springs the trap that is closest to the mouse cursor.

templar_assassin_trap_teleport.name: Psionic Projection
templar_assassin_trap_teleport.desc: CHANNELED - Allows Templar Assassin to teleport to any Psionic Trap after channeling for 2 seconds, detonating it upon arrival as if it was fully charged and instantly dealing 400 bonus damage. Channeling Psionic Projection does not break Meld.

templar_assassin_psionic_trap.name: Psionic Trap
templar_assassin_psionic_trap.desc: Templar Assassin places mystical traps that invisibly monitor enemy movement. When sprung at her command, they exert a slowing influence of 20% in a 400 radius. Trap movement slow charges up to 50% after 3.5 seconds. Deals damage after 3.5s.

templar_assassin_inner_peace.name: Inner Peace
templar_assassin_inner_peace.desc: When remaining stationary and not taking damage for 0.25s, Templar Assassin begins meditating, gaining health and mana regeneration, reaching the maximum bonus after 2.05s of meditating.

templar_assassin_third_eye.name: Third Eye
templar_assassin_third_eye.desc: Templar Assassin and her teammates can see Roshan's respawn timer.

templar_assassin_hidden_gates.name: Hidden Gates
templar_assassin_hidden_gates.desc: Templar Assassin gains access to linked portals at the edges of the map usable only by her.

templar_assassin_self_trap.name: Trap
templar_assassin_self_trap.desc: Springs the trap, slowing nearby enemies.

terrorblade_reflection.name: Reflection
terrorblade_reflection.desc: Terrorblade brings forth an invulnerable dark reflection of all enemy heroes in a target area. Affected enemy heroes have movement and attack speeds slowed and attacked by their reflection.

terrorblade_conjure_image.name: Conjure Image
terrorblade_conjure_image.desc: Creates an illusion of Terrorblade that deals damage.

terrorblade_metamorphosis.name: Metamorphosis
terrorblade_metamorphosis.desc: Terrorblade transforms into a powerful demon with a ranged attack. Any of Terrorblade's illusions that are within 1200 range will also be transformed by Metamorphosis.

terrorblade_demon_zeal.name: Demon Zeal
terrorblade_demon_zeal.desc: Costs part of Terrorblade's current HP to cast, providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed. Does not affect Reflection illusions. Can't be cast while in Metamorphosis and Metamorphosis will remove Demon Zeal.

terrorblade_terror_wave.name: Terror Wave
terrorblade_terror_wave.desc: Causes a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage, and grants Terrorblade Metamorphosis for a short time.

terrorblade_sunder.name: Sunder
terrorblade_sunder.desc: Severs the life from both Terrorblade and a target hero, exchanging a percentage of both units' current health. Some health points must remain.

terrorblade_dark_unity.name: Dark Unity
terrorblade_dark_unity.desc: Nearby Illusions created by Terrorblade have bonus attack damage.

tidehunter_gush.name: Gush
tidehunter_gush.desc: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.

tidehunter_kraken_shell.name: Kraken Shell
tidehunter_kraken_shell.desc:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of 40% movement speed. Lasts 4s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

tidehunter_anchor_smash.name: Anchor Smash
tidehunter_anchor_smash.desc: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus 225 units.

tidehunter_dead_in_the_water.name: Dead in the Water
tidehunter_dead_in_the_water.desc: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than 350 units away from the anchor forces the hero to 100 move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with 4 hero attacks.

tidehunter_ravage.name: Ravage
tidehunter_ravage.desc: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.

tidehunter_blubber.name: Blubber
tidehunter_blubber.desc:
Tidehunter's hide removes negative status effects if he takes more than 450 damage. Removes most debuffs, even if they are generally not purgable.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

tinker_laser.name: Laser
tinker_laser.desc: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.

tinker_march_of_the_machines.name: March of the Machines
tinker_march_of_the_machines.desc: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.

tinker_warp_grenade.name: Warp Flare
tinker_warp_grenade.desc:
Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for 2 seconds.

The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.

tinker_keen_teleport.name: Keen Conveyance
tinker_keen_teleport.desc: CHANNELED - Teleport to a target friendly structure. Level 2 allows teleporting to friendly units and Level 3 to friendly heroes.

tinker_rearm.name: Rearm
tinker_rearm.desc: CHANNELED - Resets the cooldown on Tinker's abilities.

tinker_eureka.name: Eureka!
tinker_eureka.desc: Tinker gains 1% item cooldown reduction per 3 Intelligence, up to a maximum of 60%.

tinker_defense_matrix.name: Defense Matrix
tinker_defense_matrix.desc: Targets an allied unit, applying an all damage barrier to them that also provides Status Resistance.

tiny_avalanche.name: Avalanche
tiny_avalanche.desc: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.

tiny_toss.name: Toss
tiny_toss.desc: Grabs the nearest unit in a 300 radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.

tiny_tree_grab.name: Tree Grab
tiny_tree_grab.desc: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks. The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.

tiny_tree_channel.name: Tree Volley
tiny_tree_channel.desc: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.

tiny_insurmountable.name: Insurmountable
tiny_insurmountable.desc: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.

tiny_grow.name: Grow
tiny_grow.desc: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.

tiny_toss_tree.name: Tree Throw
tiny_toss_tree.desc: Throws the tree at the target unit, proccing your attack on it and splashing damage around the target.

tiny_craggy_exterior.name: Craggy Exterior
tiny_craggy_exterior.desc: Enemies that attack Tiny receive a stacking debuff that lowers their attack damage with each stack.

treant_natures_grasp.name: Nature's Grasp
treant_natures_grasp.desc: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does 35% less damage to creeps.

treant_leech_seed.name: Leech Seed
treant_leech_seed.desc: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits 2 healing pulses to up to 5 nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.

treant_living_armor.name: Living Armor
treant_living_armor.desc: Infuses the target hero or structure with a protective coating which heals the target and blocks damage from player-controlled sources. Each time this spell blocks damage, the block amount is decreased. If the damage block is decreased to 0, the buff is removed early.

treant_eyes_in_the_forest.name: Eyes In The Forest
treant_eyes_in_the_forest.desc: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for 360 seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.

treant_natures_guise.name: Nature's Guise
treant_natures_guise.desc: Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for 2.75 seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.

treant_overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
treant_overgrowth.desc: Summons an overgrowth of vines and branches around Treant that deal damage to afflicted enemies and prevent them from moving, blinking, going invisible, or attacking.

treant_super_bloom.name: Super Bloom
treant_super_bloom.desc: Treant grows massive in size for 15 seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of 310, 120% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals 60% of his attack damage in a 300 unit radius.

troll_warlord_switch_stance.name: Battle Stance
troll_warlord_switch_stance.desc:
Troll Warlord swaps from using ranged to melee attacks. While melee, Troll Warlord's base attack time is improved to 1.4.

Troll Warlord gains 1 armor per 30 bonus attack speed.

troll_warlord_whirling_axes_ranged.name: Whirling Axes (Ranged)
troll_warlord_whirling_axes_ranged.desc: Troll hurls a fistful of five axes in a cone shape over 950 range, slowing and damaging enemy units.

troll_warlord_whirling_axes_melee.name: Whirling Axes (Melee)
troll_warlord_whirling_axes_melee.desc: Troll hurls two axes around him in a close range area of effect, damaging enemy units and causing them to miss some attacks.

troll_warlord_fervor.name: Fervor
troll_warlord_fervor.desc: With each continuous blow on the same target, Troll gains increased attack speed. If Troll changes targets, the stacks drop to zero.

troll_warlord_berserkers_rage.name: Berserker's Rage
troll_warlord_berserkers_rage.desc:
While in melee form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to ensnare, preventing the target from moving or using mobility spells and has additional movement speed.

When in ranged form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to Maim the target, dealing bonus damage, and slowing the target's movement and attack speed.

troll_warlord_battle_trance.name: Battle Trance
troll_warlord_battle_trance.desc:
Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within 900 range, prioritizing heroes. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

tusk_ice_shards.name: Ice Shards
tusk_ice_shards.desc: Tusk compresses shards of ice into a ball of frozen energy that damages all enemies it comes in contact with. When the ball reaches its target destination the shards are released, creating a barrier that lasts for 4 seconds.

tusk_snowball.name: Snowball
tusk_snowball.desc: Tusk begins rolling into a snowball. Allies within a 325 radius can also be added to the snowball by right-clicking on them, even while the snowball is moving. Once launched, any enemies caught in the snowball's path will be stunned and take damage. Each allied Hero in the snowball will add to its damage and stun duration.

tusk_tag_team.name: Tag Team
tusk_tag_team.desc: Activate to temporarily apply a negative debuff aura around you, causing enemies that are attacked under it to take bonus physical damage and reduced movement speed. Lasts 6 seconds.

tusk_drinking_buddies.name: Drinking Buddies
tusk_drinking_buddies.desc: Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer. Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor. Can be put on alt-cast to only pull Tusk towards his ally with 50% reduced cast range.

tusk_walrus_kick.name: Walrus Kick
tusk_walrus_kick.desc: Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within 250 radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by 50% if kicking a creep.

tusk_walrus_punch.name: Walrus PUNCH!
tusk_walrus_punch.desc: Tusk connects with his mighty Walrus Punch, a critical strike with bonus damage so powerful it launches its victim into the air.

tusk_launch_snowball.name: Launch Snowball
tusk_launch_snowball.desc: Launch the snowball toward the target.

tusk_bitter_chill.name: Bitter Chill
tusk_bitter_chill.desc: Passively slows the attack speed of all enemy heroes within a 350 unit radius.

undying_decay.name: Decay
undying_decay.desc: Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals 2x damage to creeps.

undying_soul_rip.name: Soul Rip
undying_soul_rip.desc: Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.

undying_tombstone.name: Tombstone
undying_tombstone.desc: Summons a tombstone at the target point. Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them. Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.

undying_flesh_golem.name: Flesh Golem
undying_flesh_golem.desc: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem. While in this state, he gains a percentage increase to strength, bonus movement speed, and causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies.

undying_tombstone_zombie_deathstrike.name: Deathlust
undying_tombstone_zombie_deathstrike.desc: Slows enemy units on attack. If the attacked unit's health goes below the threshold, the zombie receives enhanced movement and attack speed.

ursa_earthshock.name: Earthshock
ursa_earthshock.desc: Ursa leaps forward 250 units and slams the earth, causing a powerful shock to damage and slow all enemy units in a nearby area for 4 seconds.

ursa_overpower.name: Overpower
ursa_overpower.desc: Using his skill in combat, Ursa gains increased attack speed and slow resistance for a number of subsequent attacks.

ursa_fury_swipes.name: Fury Swipes
ursa_fury_swipes.desc: Ursa's claws dig deeper wounds in the enemy, causing consecutive attacks to the same enemy to deal more damage. If the same target is not attacked after 8 seconds, the bonus damage is lost.

ursa_maul.name: Maul
ursa_maul.desc: Ursa gains bonus damage equal to a percentage of his Current HP.

ursa_enrage.name: Enrage
ursa_enrage.desc:
Ursa goes into a frenzy, providing damage reduction and status resistance. Removes any existing debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

ursa_bear_down.name: Bear Down
ursa_bear_down.desc: Debuffs inflicted by Ursa last longer.

vengefulspirit_magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
vengefulspirit_magic_missile.desc: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.

vengefulspirit_wave_of_terror.name: Wave of Terror
vengefulspirit_wave_of_terror.desc: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.

vengefulspirit_command_aura.name: Vengeance Aura
vengefulspirit_command_aura.desc: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives 20% extra bonus.

vengefulspirit_retribution.name: Retribution
vengefulspirit_retribution.desc:
Vengeful Spirit is considered both a ranged and a melee attacker to gain the respective bonuses.

When killed by an enemy hero, Vengeful Spirit deals 20% bonus damage to her killer until their next death. Only one debuff can exist at a time.

vengefulspirit_nether_swap.name: Nether Swap
vengefulspirit_nether_swap.desc: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.

vengefulspirit_soul_strike.name: Soul Strike
vengefulspirit_soul_strike.desc: Vengeful Spirit's ranged attacks behave as if they were melee attacks.

venomancer_venomous_gale.name: Venomous Gale
venomancer_venomous_gale.desc: Launches a ball of venom in a line, poisoning enemy units so that they take both initial damage and damage over time, as well as suffering slowed movement. Venomous Gale deals damage every 3 seconds over its duration.

venomancer_snakebite.name: Snakebite
venomancer_snakebite.desc: Venomancer summons a Spawn of Aktok to sink its fangs into a target, dealing magic damage and applying a toxin that does damage every second. When the target attacks while infected, they take the initial damage again.

venomancer_plague_ward.name: Plague Ward
venomancer_plague_ward.desc: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Wards gain the Poison Sting level from Venomancer, dealing 50% of the full damage.

venomancer_poison_sting.name: Poison Sting
venomancer_poison_sting.desc: Venomancer's attacks slow enemies and deal damage over time.

venomancer_noxious_plague.name: Noxious Plague
venomancer_noxious_plague.desc: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.

venomancer_sepsis.name: Septic Shock
venomancer_sepsis.desc: Venomancer's attacks deal extra damage based on how many debuffs the attack target has. Extra damage is dealt as magical damage. Only counts debuffs from Venomancer or his Plague Wards.

viper_poison_attack.name: Poison Attack
viper_poison_attack.desc: Intensifies Viper's venom, adding an effect to his normal attack that applies a stacking movement speed slow and magic resistance deduction while dealing damage over time. Stacks up to 6 times.

viper_nethertoxin.name: Nethertoxin
viper_nethertoxin.desc: Viper releases a Nethertoxin at the targeted area. Units in that area take an increasing damage over time based on how long they remain in it. Units in it have their attack speed slowed.

viper_corrosive_skin.name: Corrosive Skin
viper_corrosive_skin.desc: Viper exudes an infectious toxin that damages and slows the attack speed of any enemy that damages it in a 1200 radius. The acid exudate also increases Viper's resistance to magic.

viper_nose_dive.name: Nosedive
viper_nose_dive.desc: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a 500 AoE for 4 seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.

viper_viper_strike.name: Viper Strike
viper_viper_strike.desc: Viper slows the targeted enemy unit's movement and attack speed while also disabling their passives and dealing poison damage over time. The slowing effect reduces over the duration of the poison.

visage_grave_chill.name: Grave Chill
visage_grave_chill.desc: Visage drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining the drained speed for itself and nearby Familiars.

visage_soul_assumption.name: Soul Assumption
visage_soul_assumption.desc: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than 100 damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.

visage_gravekeepers_cloak.name: Gravekeeper's Cloak
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.desc:
Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage. If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.

Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within 900 range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.

visage_stone_form_self_cast.name: Stone Form
visage_stone_form_self_cast.desc:
Orders the Familiar closest to Visage to cast Stone Form in its current location, turning into stone and smashing into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area. The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly. After 6 seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form.

 Can be alt-cast to order the closest Familiar to the target location to move there and cast Stone Form.

visage_silent_as_the_grave.name: Silent as the Grave
visage_silent_as_the_grave.desc: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed. Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for 2s.

visage_summon_familiars.name: Summon Familiars
visage_summon_familiars.desc:
Conjures 2 blind Familiars to fight for Visage. Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing. While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health. Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after 4s, during which they cannot attack or act.

visage_summon_familiars_stone_form.name: Stone Form
visage_summon_familiars_stone_form.desc:
After a short delay, the Familiar turns into stone and smashes into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area. The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly. After 6 seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form. 

 Can be alt-cast to order the Familiar to move to the target location and cast Stone Form.

visage_lurker.name: Lurker
visage_lurker.desc:
Visage's ability cooldown durations are accelerated as long as he's not taking damage.

Grants a stack every 2s that Visage does not take damage. Each stack grants 2% cooldown acceleration with a max of 8 stacks. Stacks fade after 2s upon taking any damage.

visage_summon_familiars_recall.name: Recall Familiar
visage_summon_familiars_recall.desc: Recall this familiar to Visage after 4s, during which they cannot attack or act.

void_spirit_aether_remnant.name: Aether Remnant
void_spirit_aether_remnant.desc: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.

void_spirit_dissimilate.name: Dissimilate
void_spirit_dissimilate.desc: Void Spirit temporarily fades into the aether, creating a number of portals through which he can reassemble himself. Upon exiting a portal, he damages all enemies in the area.

void_spirit_resonant_pulse.name: Resonant Pulse
void_spirit_resonant_pulse.desc: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.

void_spirit_intrinsic_edge.name: Intrinsic Edge
void_spirit_intrinsic_edge.desc: Void Spirit gains 15% more attack damage per point of each attribute, and 30% more HP regen from Strength, attack speed from Agility, and mana regen from Intelligence.

void_spirit_astral_step.name: Astral Step
void_spirit_astral_step.desc: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for 1.25 seconds and then detonates.

void_spirit_symmetry.name: Symmetry
void_spirit_symmetry.desc: Void Spirit gains a physical damage barrier when dealing magic damage to enemy heroes.

warlock_fatal_bonds.name: Fatal Bonds
warlock_fatal_bonds.desc: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.

warlock_shadow_word.name: Shadow Word
warlock_shadow_word.desc: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.

warlock_upheaval.name: Upheaval
warlock_upheaval.desc: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to 10 seconds. Enemies are slowed for 1 second after leaving the area or the spell ends.

warlock_eldritch_summoning.name: Eldritch Summoning
warlock_eldritch_summoning.desc: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for 15 seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.

warlock_rain_of_chaos.name: Chaotic Offering
warlock_rain_of_chaos.desc: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for 0.8 seconds. The Golem lives 60 seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.

warlock_golem_flaming_fists.name: Flaming Fists
warlock_golem_flaming_fists.desc: Deals extra damage to nearby units when attacking.

warlock_golem_permanent_immolation.name: Permanent Immolation
warlock_golem_permanent_immolation.desc: Burns the Golem's nearby enemy units, dealing damage per second.

warlock_imp_explode.name: Eldritch Explosion
warlock_imp_explode.desc: Shortly after dying, a burst of magic damage is dealt to all enemies in a small area. Does 50% less damage to non-hero targets.

weaver_the_swarm.name: The Swarm
weaver_the_swarm.desc: Weaver launches a swarm of 12 young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor until it is killed.

weaver_shukuchi.name: Shukuchi
weaver_shukuchi.desc: Weaver shifts out of visibility, gaining max movement speed and doing harm to any enemies it passes through.

weaver_geminate_attack.name: Geminate Attack
weaver_geminate_attack.desc: Allows Weaver to dispatch two attacks at once.

weaver_time_lapse.name: Time Lapse
weaver_time_lapse.desc:
Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier--regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

weaver_threads_of_fate.name: Threads of Fate
weaver_threads_of_fate.desc: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within 700 range of them for 1.5s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.

weaver_rewoven.name: Rewoven
weaver_rewoven.desc: Every time Weaver damages an enemy hero with an ability, he gains 6 experience.

windrunner_shackleshot.name: Shackleshot
windrunner_shackleshot.desc: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it. If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to 0.6.

windrunner_powershot.name: Powershot
windrunner_powershot.desc: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to 1 second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.

windrunner_windrun.name: Windrun
windrunner_windrun.desc: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.

windrunner_gale_force.name: Gale Force
windrunner_gale_force.desc: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.

windrunner_focusfire.name: Focus Fire
windrunner_focusfire.desc: Windranger channels the wind to gain 0 additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage. Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.

windrunner_tailwind.name: Tailwind
windrunner_tailwind.desc:
Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.

Passively increases Windranger's max movement speed.

windrunner_easy_breezy.name: Easy Breezy
windrunner_easy_breezy.desc: Windranger's movement speed cannot be lower than 240 and can reach 600.

winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.name: Arctic Burn
winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.desc: Winter Wyvern soars upon an arctic wind, granting her unobstructed movement and allowing her to exhale a blistering chill into each attack. While soaring, her attacks travel further and faster, and slow enemies with a magical freeze that strips them of 4% of their current health each second.

winter_wyvern_splinter_blast.name: Splinter Blast
winter_wyvern_splinter_blast.desc: Launches a ball of brittle ice toward a unit. The ice shatters on impact, leaving the primary target completely unaffected, while hurling damaging splinters into nearby enemies in a 500 base radius. Enemies struck by these splinters are slowed by 28%.

winter_wyvern_cold_embrace.name: Cold Embrace
winter_wyvern_cold_embrace.desc: Encases an ally in an icy cocoon, freezing them solid while healing a base amount as well as a percentage of their maximum health each second. The cocoon blocks all physical damage.

winter_wyvern_winters_curse.name: Winter's Curse
winter_wyvern_winters_curse.desc: Winter Wyvern dispells then freezes an enemy in place while striking those nearby with a maddening curse which causes them to attack their frozen ally with increased attack speed. The frozen ally and those cursed to attack their ally are immune to all damage from their enemies with the exception of damage from Winter Wyvern or her controlled units.

winter_wyvern_eldwurm_scholar.name: Eldwurm Scholar
winter_wyvern_eldwurm_scholar.desc: When an enemy hero casts an Ultimate ability within 1200 of Winter Wyvern, she receives experience equal to 25% of the ultimate's manacost.

winter_wyvern_essence_of_the_blueheart.name: Essence of the Blueheart
winter_wyvern_essence_of_the_blueheart.desc: Winter Wyvern's heals also restore mana.

winter_wyvern_dragon_sight.name: Dragon Sight
winter_wyvern_dragon_sight.desc: Winter Wyvern gains bonus damage when her attack range is over 400.

winter_wyvern_accelerated_learning.name: Eldwurm Studies
winter_wyvern_accelerated_learning.desc: Winter Wyvern can skill this ability to reduce all ability and talent level requirements by 1. On the next level up, Winter Wyvern will receive an additional ability point for every level that was put into Eldwurm Studies since the last level up.

wisp_tether.name: Tether
wisp_tether.desc: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.

wisp_spirits.name: Spirits
wisp_spirits.desc: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it. Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode. When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.

wisp_overcharge.name: Overcharge
wisp_overcharge.desc: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.

wisp_spirits_in.name: Spirits In
wisp_spirits_in.desc: Sends the spirits closer to you. Can be toggled on and off.

wisp_spirits_out.name: Spirits Out
wisp_spirits_out.desc: Sends the spirits farther away from you. Can be toggled on and off.

wisp_relocate.name: Relocate
wisp_relocate.desc: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.

wisp_tether_break.name: Break Tether
wisp_tether_break.desc: Break the link to the tethered unit.

wisp_equilibrium.name: Equilibrium
wisp_equilibrium.desc: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.

wisp_essence_conduction.name: Wellspring
wisp_essence_conduction.desc: Io regenerates from consumables and the fountain 2x faster.

witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.name: Paralyzing Cask
witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.desc: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.

witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.name: Voodoo Restoration
witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.desc: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.

witch_doctor_maledict.name: Maledict
witch_doctor_maledict.desc: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled units in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.

witch_doctor_voodoo_switcheroo.name: Voodoo Switcheroo
witch_doctor_voodoo_switcheroo.desc: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.

witch_doctor_gris_gris.name: Gris-Gris
witch_doctor_gris_gris.desc:
Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, 100% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every 3s. 

 Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.

witch_doctor_death_ward.name: Death Ward
witch_doctor_death_ward.desc: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of 8 seconds. Death Ward has 50% bonus accuracy.

zuus_arc_lightning.name: Arc Lightning
zuus_arc_lightning.desc: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.

zuus_lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
zuus_lightning_bolt.desc: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a 600 radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in 325 range.

zuus_heavenly_jump.name: Heavenly Jump
zuus_heavenly_jump.desc: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets 900 unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.

zuus_cloud.name: Nimbus
zuus_cloud.desc: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.

zuus_lightning_hands.name: Lightning Hands
zuus_lightning_hands.desc: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.

zuus_thundergods_wrath.name: Thundergod's Wrath
zuus_thundergods_wrath.desc: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.

zuus_static_field.name: Static Field
zuus_static_field.desc: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit by his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.

creep_irresolute.name: Runty
creep_irresolute.desc: Runty Units Deal reduced damage to hero units.

flagbearer_creep_aura_effect.name: Inspiration Aura
flagbearer_creep_aura_effect.desc: The Flagbearer inspires all allied creeps, granting them bonus health regeneration and magic resistance.

kobold_tunneler_prospecting.name: Prospecting Aura
kobold_tunneler_prospecting.desc: Kobolds are adept at finding gold, increasing nearby allied heroes' GPM.

kobold_disarm.name: Steal Weapon
kobold_disarm.desc: Every third attack Kobold Soldier will disarm its target temporarily. Attack counter doesn't increase while ability is on cooldown.

kobold_taskmaster_speed_aura.name: Speed Aura
kobold_taskmaster_speed_aura.desc: The Kobold Foreman's cruel efficiency increases his movement speed and the movement speed of all nearby allies.

mudgolem_cloak_aura.name: Cloak Aura
mudgolem_cloak_aura.desc: This creature protects its allies with a Magic resistance aura. Creeps are better protected.

furbolg_enrage_attack_speed.name: Death Throe: Rush
furbolg_enrage_attack_speed.desc: When Hellbear dies, all nearby allies go into a frenzy gaining attack speed for a short amount of time.

polar_furbolg_ursa_warrior_thunder_clap.name: Thunder Clap
polar_furbolg_ursa_warrior_thunder_clap.desc: The Hellbear Smasher claps his massive hands together, creating a deafening blast. The blast damages nearby enemies and throws them off their footing.

furbolg_enrage_damage.name: Death Throe: Power
furbolg_enrage_damage.desc: When Hellbear Smasher dies, all nearby allies go into a rampage gaining bonus attack damage for a short amount of time.

warpine_raider_seed_shot.name: Seed Shot
warpine_raider_seed_shot.desc: Hucks a seed at a target, slowing and damaging it. The seed can bounce multiple times to nearby targets.

mud_golem_hurl_boulder.name: Hurl Boulder
mud_golem_hurl_boulder.desc: Hurls a boulder at the target, damaging and stunning them.

mud_golem_rock_destroy.name: Shard Split
mud_golem_rock_destroy.desc: On death, Mud Golems shatter into several Shard Golems.

ogre_bruiser_ogre_smash.name: Ogre Smash!
ogre_bruiser_ogre_smash.desc: Ogre slowly charges a big attack stunning for 2.4 seconds and dealing 200 + 8% of their current HP as damage to all units in front of him.

giant_wolf_intimidate.name: Intimidate
giant_wolf_intimidate.desc: The Giant Wolf's ferocious roar reduces all nearby enemies total attack damage.

alpha_wolf_critical_strike.name: Critical Strike
alpha_wolf_critical_strike.desc: The cruel Alpha Wolf attacks his enemy's unprotected vitals at every opportunity, inflicting critical damage.

alpha_wolf_command_aura.name: Packleader's Aura
alpha_wolf_command_aura.desc: The Alpha Wolf's ruthless attacks do extra damage. His commanding presence inspires nearby allies to attack ruthlessly as well.

enraged_wildkin_tornado.name: Tornado
enraged_wildkin_tornado.desc: CHANNELED - The Wildwing calls on the spirit of the wind, creating a sentient Tornado that he can control. The Tornado slows nearby enemies and does damage. It is invulnerable and can move anywhere.

enraged_wildkin_hurricane.name: Hurricane
enraged_wildkin_hurricane.desc: The Wildwing Ripper calls on the spirit of the wind, creating a hurricane that can push a unit in the direction of Wildwing Ripper's choice.

enraged_wildkin_toughness_aura.name: Toughness Aura
enraged_wildkin_toughness_aura.desc: The Wildwing Ripper's fury numbs it to attacks and inspires nearby allies to withstand more blows.

satyr_soulstealer_mana_burn.name: Mana Burn
satyr_soulstealer_mana_burn.desc: The Satyr Mindstealer removes a fragment of his enemy's soul, burning away mana equal to 20 + 1x the target's intelligence, and dealing damage equal to the amount of mana burned.

forest_troll_high_priest_mana_aura.name: Mana Aura
forest_troll_high_priest_mana_aura.desc: Provides bonus mana regeneration to all nearby allies.

satyr_hellcaller_shockwave.name: Shockwave
satyr_hellcaller_shockwave.desc: The Satyr Tormenter tears open an unstable rift to the underworld, creating a shockwave that travels in a line along the ground, dealing damage to enemies it hits.

satyr_hellcaller_unholy_aura.name: Unholy Aura
satyr_hellcaller_unholy_aura.desc: The Satyr Tormenter's demonic communion allows him to emanate regenerative power, increasing the health regeneration of himself and all nearby allies.

spawnlord_aura.name: Prowler Aura
spawnlord_aura.desc: Gives lifesteal and health regeneration to nearby allies.

spawnlord_master_stomp.name: Desecrate
spawnlord_master_stomp.desc: Stomps the ground, dealing damage to nearby units and reducing their base physical armor by 50%.

spawnlord_master_freeze.name: Petrify
spawnlord_master_freeze.desc: Causes the next attack to petrify the enemy, rooting them and dealing 100 damage per second.

ancient_rock_golem_weakening_aura.name: Weakening Aura
ancient_rock_golem_weakening_aura.desc: The Rock Golem's imposing figure makes enemies more susceptible to Physical Damage.

granite_golem_hp_aura.name: Granite Aura
granite_golem_hp_aura.desc: Increases the health capacity of nearby units.

ice_shaman_incendiary_bomb.name: Icefire Bomb
ice_shaman_incendiary_bomb.desc: The Ice Shaman chucks a blue flame towards an enemy unit or building, dealing damage over time.

frostbitten_golem_time_warp_aura.name: Time Warp Aura
frostbitten_golem_time_warp_aura.desc: Coming from a different era, the Frostbitten Golem has an innate control of time, speeding up the cooldowns of all nearby allies.

big_thunder_lizard_slam.name: Slam
big_thunder_lizard_slam.desc: The Ancient Thunderhide slams his mammoth body against the ground. The shock damages nearby enemies and throws them off their footing. Heroes regain their balance more quickly.

big_thunder_lizard_frenzy.name: Frenzy
big_thunder_lizard_frenzy.desc: The Ancient Thunderhide works an ally into a frenzy, causing his ally to have increased attack speed.

big_thunder_lizard_wardrums_aura.name: War Drums Aura
big_thunder_lizard_wardrums_aura.desc: The rhythm of the Thunderhide's heartbeat increases the attack speed and accuracy of nearby allies.

gnoll_assassin_envenomed_weapon.name: Envenomed Weapon
gnoll_assassin_envenomed_weapon.desc: The Vhoul Assassin has soaked his weapons in his own blend of painful predator venoms that causes his enemies' natural regeneration to work against themselves. Heroes recover from the poison more quickly.

creep_piercing.name: Piercing
creep_piercing.desc: Piercing Units Deal Bonus Damage to non-hero, non-heavy units and reduced damage to heroes and heavy units.

ghost_frost_attack.name: Frost Attack
ghost_frost_attack.desc: The Ghost launches an eerie attack that chills her enemies to their bones.

dark_troll_warlord_ensnare.name: Ensnare
dark_troll_warlord_ensnare.desc: The Dark Troll Summoner tosses netting around an enemy's feet, briefly immobilizing the unit, though the unit can still attack and use abilities.

dark_troll_warlord_raise_dead.name: Raise Dead
dark_troll_warlord_raise_dead.desc: The Dark Troll Summoner stirs the ground underfoot, raising the remains of trolls long dead, bringing to life three skeleton Warriors who will fight at his side.

satyr_trickster_purge.name: Purge
satyr_trickster_purge.desc:
The Satyr Banisher knows every trick in the book, allowing him to dispel debuffs from allies or buffs from enemies. His trickery also slows the enemy's movement.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

berserker_troll_break.name: Break
berserker_troll_break.desc: Whenever Hill Troll Berserker attacks a unit it applies break to it.

forest_troll_high_priest_heal.name: Heal
forest_troll_high_priest_heal.desc: The Hill Troll Priest lays his holy blessing upon the target ally, replenishing some health.

forest_troll_high_priest_heal_amp_aura.name: Heal Amplification Aura
forest_troll_high_priest_heal_amp_aura.desc: Provides bonus Heal Amplification to all nearby allies.

harpy_scout_take_off.name: Take Off
harpy_scout_take_off.desc: Harpy Scout gains flying movement at the cost of movement speed. Consumes mana while active.

harpy_storm_chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
harpy_storm_chain_lightning.desc: The Harpy Stormcrafter releases a high-voltage bolt of electricity at the target enemy, dealing damage. The bolt jumps to other nearby enemies, losing power with each jump.

black_drake_magic_amplification_aura.name: Magic Amplification Aura
black_drake_magic_amplification_aura.desc: The Black Drakes' gaze make enemies more susceptible to Spell Damage.

black_dragon_fireball.name: Fireball
black_dragon_fireball.desc: Hurls a fire blast on the ground, igniting the area in a 300 radius for 8 seconds. Enemies caught in the fire will take 85 damage per second.

black_dragon_splash_attack.name: Splash Attack
black_dragon_splash_attack.desc: The Black Dragon's explosive attacks are felt by all nearby enemies.

black_dragon_dragonhide_aura.name: Dragonhide Aura
black_dragon_dragonhide_aura.desc: The Ancient Black Dragon's dreaded presence grants nearby allies additional armor. This bonus can stack with itself.

creep_siege.name: Reinforced
creep_siege.desc: Reinforced Units and Buildings Deal Bonus Damage to other Reinforced Units and Buildings and take less attack damage from other units.

forged_spirit_melting_strike.name: Melting Strike
forged_spirit_melting_strike.desc: Melts away the armor of heroes hit by the spirit's attack. Each successive hit increases the amount of armor melted.

tornado_tempest.name: Tempest
tornado_tempest.desc: The Tornado's overpowering winds slow all nearby enemies, flinging debris at them and inflicting damage every second. Enemies closer to the center of the Tornado take more damage.

hill_troll_rally.name: Rally
hill_troll_rally.desc: Skeleton's allies gain bonus attack damage. This Aura stacks.

neutral_spell_immunity.name: Spell Immunity
neutral_spell_immunity.desc: This creature does not feel the effects of most magical spells.

frogmen_riverborn_aura.name: Riverborn Aura
frogmen_riverborn_aura.desc: Whenever the Frog is in water, it increases all allied movement speed and outgoing damage.

frogmen_arm_of_the_deep.name: Arm of the Deep
frogmen_arm_of_the_deep.desc: Sends out a slew of tentacles in the target direction, stunning and damaging enemies.

frogmen_tendrils_of_the_deep.name: Tendrils of the Deep
frogmen_tendrils_of_the_deep.desc: Sends out a cone-shaped slew of tentacles in the target direction, stunning and damaging enemies.

frogmen_congregation_of_the_deep.name: Congregations of the Deep
frogmen_congregation_of_the_deep.desc: Sends out a slew of tentacles in all directions, stunning and damaging enemies.

frogmen_water_bubble_small.name: Water Bubble (Small)
frogmen_water_bubble_small.desc: Creates a barrier bubble that protects the target from magic damage for 10s.

frogmen_water_bubble_medium.name: Water Bubble (Medium)
frogmen_water_bubble_medium.desc: Creates a barrier bubble that protects the target from magic damage for 10s. After it expires, it heals the target for 50% of the absorb amount.

frogmen_water_bubble_large.name: Water Bubble (Large)
frogmen_water_bubble_large.desc: Creates a barrier bubble that protects the target from magic damage for 10s. After it expires, it heals the target and all allies in the radius for 50% of the absorb amount.
